items.title: How Europe’s intensifying marine heatwaves threaten its fisheries
items.author: Ben Welsh, Simon Jessop, Kate Abnett
items.creator: Ben Welsh, Simon Jessop, Kate Abnett
items.body:
As drought spread and wildfires raged across Europe this summer, the extraordinary heat didn't stop at the shoreline.
European waters notched their hottest summer months since satellite sensors began providing reliable data in 1982, according to a Reuters analysis of temperatures recorded at the seas’ surface.
Records fell from the English Channel to the Mediterranean Sea, with an offshore buoy near Mallorca recording a temperature of 33.02 degrees Celsius (91.44 degrees Fahrenheit) on August 5, the highest ever registered in the Spanish port authority’s buoy network.
Scientists warn that events like this year’s marine heatwaves are becoming more frequent, more intense and more widespread as greenhouse-gas emissions drive up atmospheric temperatures around the globe. The world’s oceans absorb the majority of the excess heat and retain it longer than the land or atmosphere.
That’s transforming marine ecosystems, with catastrophic consequences for some European fisheries and the people who rely on them, according to a review of the scientific literature and interviews with more than a dozen researchers, fishing industry sources and analysts. Species that have sustained some coastal communities in Spain and southern England for generations are disappearing, as unfamiliar arrivals surge into newly hospitable waters.

The cool waters of the Bay of Biscay once gave life to extensive kelp forests. But the seaweed stands that sustained small-scale fisheries for generations are disappearing from the coast of northern Spain. REUTERS/Maria Alejandra Cardona

"What is surprising is the speed at which this occurs," Jean-Pierre Gattuso, senior research scientist at France's National Centre for Scientific Research , said of Europe’s warming seas. “Records are broken almost every day in many places.”
Taken together, European seas averaged 21.6 C (70.9 F) between June and August, the highest in 45 years of available data.
Few areas strayed further from the norm this summer than the Bay of Biscay, off the Atlantic-facing coast of France and Spain.
Stretching from Cape Ortegal in Galicia to the Pointe de Penmarch in southern Brittany, the bay's traditionally cool waters averaged 21.4 C (70.5 F) between June and August, more than 2.4 degrees (4.4 degrees) above the 1991-2020 average. Readings from the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration peaked on August 13 at 23.2 C (74 F), the highest of the satellite era.
Scientists define a marine heatwave as five or more days of water temperatures well above an area’s historic norm. In the 1980s, the Bay of Biscay averaged a handful of heatwave days per year. By the end of August, it had logged 186 this year, more than three out of every four days, Reuters found.
DISAPPEARING KELP, LOBSTER, CRAYFISH The Bay of Biscay’s cool waters, long prized by Spaniards seeking relief from the heat of the Mediterranean coast, were immortalized in Ernest Hemingway's 1926 novel "The Sun Also Rises." The book’s protagonist recovers after weeks of dissolution on the northern beaches of San Sebastian.
"Now if you want to swim in cold water, you have to go to the westernmost portion of Galicia,” in the far northwestern corner of Spain, said Jose Manuel Rico Ordas, a professor of marine ecology at the University of Oviedo in the northern Asturias region.
Galicia benefits from strong winds that push warm surface water away from the coast during the summer months, allowing cold, deep-sea water to take its place in a process known as upwelling.
Rico Ordas has been spending summers on the bay since he was a child and now studies its transformation.
Back then, there were extensive underwater forests of kelp, which provide vital food, shelter and nurseries for dozens of species that sustain the region’s small-scale fisheries. But he estimates roughly 95% of the large, brown seaweed stands have disappeared, based on sampling along the rugged Asturias coast since 2010. He attributes the decline primarily to climate change.
Kelp needs cold water – typically below 20 C (68 F) – to survive. Higher temperatures were once exceptionally rare in the bay, Rico Ordas told Reuters.
"Now, it's the opposite," he said.
Fish overgrazing – in particular by dreamfish, which thrive in warmer temperatures – has added to the kelp’s decline, he said.
The impacts have been stark.
"We are finding no more lobster, no more crayfish, no more sea urchins and many other species that are associated with the good status of kelp forests," Rico Ordas said.
Concerned fishermen have been teaming up with scientists and environmental activists to try to restore kelp forests by planting seedlings grown in laboratories.
Manuel Angel Reiriz Gonzalez, president of a local fishermen’s guild in Galicia, recently ferried members of one such project in a boat he uses for sport fishing charters out of the port of Ribeira. The group brought a box full of small stones seeded with kelp, which they tossed into the choppy waters.

Volunteers toss small stones seeded with kelp into the water off the coast of Galicia in northern Spain. They hope such efforts can help reverse damage caused by the warming seas. REUTERS/Maria Alejandra Cardona

Climate change threatens a way of life that has sustained Gonzalez’s community for generations, he said. His family has been diving for sea urchins and harvesting clams for more than a century. But now, he said, recurring heatwaves are hurting shellfish stocks.
The area has also seen an influx of Portuguese man o' war and trigger fish from warmer climes to the south – species that prey on local fish and crustaceans.
“We had some very bad years for clam production, but we worked on seeding them, and the species gradually adapted,” Gonzalez said.
Jose Manuel Rico Ordas, a professor of marine ecology at the University of Oviedo, surveys the Lamuno coast in northern Spain on August 23, 2026. He estimates around 95% of the region's kelp forests have been lost. REUTERS/Maria Alejandra Cardona We are finding no more lobster, no more crayfish, no more sea urchins and many other species that are associated with the good status of kelp forests,
Jose Manuel Rico Ordas, a professor of marine ecology at the University of Oviedo
He hopes the seabed restoration efforts can do the same for kelp forests.
The disappearance of kelp could lead to the decline of sea urchins and other species fishermen depend on, he said. “At that point, as a fishing guild, we would cease to exist.”
‘OCTOPUS APOCALYPSE’ In other European waters, new, invasive species from the Red Sea and beyond are entering the Mediterranean through the Suez Canal, displacing native populations, reshaping food chains and threatening fisheries, researchers say. In all, there are more than 1,000 non-indigenous species in the Mediterranean, according to a recent report by the Cyprus Academy of Sciences, Letters and Arts, based on surveys by scientists in 11 countries.
Some native species are coping with the warmer temperatures better than others.
A massive swarm of jellyfish shut down reactors at France’s Gravelines nuclear power plant in August when they clogged its cooling system – for the second time in as many years. The plant in northern France is cooled from a canal connected to the North Sea.
Fishermen on the south coast of England are reporting a surge in landings of common octopus. Around 2,600 metric tons were caught last year and upwards of 3,000 tons so far this year, according to figures compiled by the UK Marine Management Organisation. Before 2025, annual landings were less than 30 tons.
Octopus larvae are carried into British waters on currents from breeding grounds near the Channel Islands, Brittany and places further south, said Bryce Stewart, senior research fellow at the Plymouth-based Marine Biological Association (MBA).
Previously, many didn’t survive the frigid temperatures. But since 2022, the English Channel has been under heatwave conditions for around six months out of the year on average, logging more than 900 days in all, the Reuters analysis found.
“Now they're actually breeding in UK water quite prolifically,” Stewart said.
For Ian Perkes, owner of the eponymous fish merchants in the south Devon seaside town of Brixham, the octopus bloom has proved a boon.
An octopus at Porthkerris reef, off Cornwall in southwestern England, in August 2025. Fishermen in the region are reporting a surge in octopus landings. Kirsty Andrews/Handout via REUTERS An octopus in a lobster pot at the Inshore Potting Area in south Devon, England, in May 2025. Some shellfishermen have switched to catching them. South Devon and Channel Shellfishermen/Handout via REUTERS Octopus eggs in the Babbacombe district of Torquay in southern England in June 2025. Researchers say octopuses are now breeding quite prolifically in British waters. Dan Bolt/Handout via REUTERS There is a ready market in southern Europe for the once-rare species and no fishing quotas, he said. "There was one week where we had 200,000 kilos (200 tons).”
But not everyone profits from the shellfish-loving octopuses, which feed on local lobsters, brown crabs and scallops.
For members of the South Devon and Channel Shellfishermen’s cooperative, 2026 has been an “octopus apocalypse,” according to its executive officer, Beshlie Pool. One recent fishing trip yielded a single crab all day, she said.
The MBA estimates the octopus bloom could account for about £10 million ($13.25 million) in lost shellfish catches against about £12 million in octopus landings between January and September 2025. But the benefits are not evenly distributed.
Some shellfishermen have switched to catching octopuses, but many do not have the necessary equipment, Pool said. Four of the coop’s 90-some vessels have gone out of business in the past 12 months.
The unpredictability of the changes makes it hard to adapt, Stewart added.
"Will the octopus still be here next year?” he asked. “If they've eaten all the crabs and lobsters, and the octopus die off, then what do we do?"

Methodology Sea-surface temperatures are based on data compiled by the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration and the European Union’s Copernicus Climate Change Service .
European waters are defined as a combination of six marine regions identified by the European Environment Agency , which does not include Arctic areas or Macaronesia. Boundaries for the Bay of Biscay and the English Channel are taken from the International Hydrographic Organization .
Marine heatwaves are calculated by comparing temperature readings for a given location against the maximum values observed there between 1991 and 2020 at that time of year. When readings rank among the top 10% of values recorded over the 30-year baseline for at least five days, the area is deemed to be experiencing a heatwave.
Access the code used to produce the analysis on GitHub .

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-オープンＡＩ、エージェント暴走の全容解明に数カ月　新たな問題事例も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Deepa Seetharaman　Raphael Satter　Jeff Horwitz

[サンフランシスコ／ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Deepa Seetharaman　Raphael Satter　Jeff Horwitz

[サンフランシスコ／ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩが開発中のＡＩが米新興ハギングフェイスのシステムに不正侵入したと公表してから２カ月が経過したが、同社はなおもＡＩエージェントの暴走の全容解明に努めている。２人の関係者がロイターに語った。

オープンＡＩは２５日、同社のＡＩエージェントがチャットＧＰＴユーザーから５３枚の画像を漏洩させたと発表した。同社は、これらの画像がＡＩによって生成されたものなのか、実在の人物を特定したものなのかについては明らかにしなかった。また、画像の漏洩時期についても言及を避けた。

オープンＡＩが現在も続けているエージェント暴走事例の全容究明は、同社がテストしているモデルの性能と、その行動を監督あるいは追跡する能力との間に、大きな隔たりがあることを浮き彫りにしている。

関係者によると、９月中旬時点でオープンＡＩがエージェントによる望ましくない行動を約２４件発見したと推定されるが、同社のチームがエージェントの活動に関する内部ログを精査するにつれ、その数は増え続けている。

オープンＡＩは、作業の規模を考慮すると、エージェントの不適切な活動に関する調査の完了には数カ月を要すると発表した。また、こうした活動について数十の第三者機関に通知したと明らかにした。

同社によると、今回流出した画像の大部分はすでに削除されており、残りの画像についてもホスティングプロバイダーに対し削除を要請している。

同社や元従業員、および専門家は、オープンＡＩのエージェントがこれらの画像にアクセスできた理由について、同社がモデル学習プロセスの一部で匿名化されたユーザーデータに依存しているためだと指摘する。企業データは学習の対象外である一方、チャットＧＰＴの一般ユーザーは、同社が自身のデータを学習に利用することを許可しないようオプトアウトする必要がある。

同社は、ユーザーの投稿がトレーニングに使用される前に、メタデータや氏名、その他の連絡先情報を削除する匿名化プロセスを経ており、個々のユーザーまで遡ることは困難になるはずだと説明した。

だが関係者によると、個人を特定できる情報がデータから完全に除去されていない可能性があり、モデルの稼働過程で情報が漏洩する恐れがあるという。

 オープンＡＩは２５日、同社のモデルが研究およびトレーニング中に米国証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）と米国国勢調査局のウェブサイトから情報にアクセスしたが、不正アクセス、アカウントの乗っ取り、またはセキュリティー侵害の証拠は見つからなかったと発表した。

これとは別に、ＡＩ研究を行う非営利団体Transluceは、オープンＡＩに由来するとみられるエージェントが、米国教育省の公民権関連ウェブサイトをハッキングしようとしたが失敗したと発表した。

オープンＡＩは、ＡＩの不正行為に関する透明性を高める必要性が一般的にあることを認め、こうした事象を開示するための新たな枠組みを発表し、「重要性が不確かな場合でも」透明性を優先するとした。

それでも、同社によるエージェントの活動調査に詳しい２人の関係者は、その調査が厳重に管理され、社内の弁護士によって形作られていると述べた。

items.title: India orders captive coal plants to maximise power output on surging demand
items.author: Sarita Singh, Sethuraman R
items.creator: Sarita Singh, Sethuraman R
items.summary: India has ordered more than 100 captive coal-fired power plants to operate at maximum capacity from October 1 through year-end to meet what it expects will be a rise in electricity demand.
items.body:
India has ordered more than 100 captive coal-fired power plants to operate at maximum capacity from October 1 through year-end to meet what it expects will be a rise in electricity demand.
The federal power ministry's order, invoked under emergency provisions of the Electricity Act, applies to plants with installed capacity of at least 50 megawatts
The aim is to meet an "expected rise in electricity demand in the coming months," showed the order dated September 25 and seen by Reuters
Nearly 40% of coal-fired plants are operating with [USN:L4N45D0BN TEXT:"critically low fuel stock"] due to a surge in power demand as the El Niño climate phenomenon raises temperatures more than usual
The plants primarily serve industrial facilities such as aluminium smelters, steel manufacturers, cement factories and oil refineries
The power ministry has directed generators to sell surplus electricity through power exchanges
The order covers 112 plants belonging to companies including Vedanta (VDAN.NS) , Tata Steel (TISC.NS) , Hindalco Industries (HALC.NS) , JSW Steel (JSTL.NS) , UltraTech Cement (ULTC.NS) , Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) , Indian Oil (IOC.NS) , Bharat Aluminium (BHLNO.UL), Hindustan Zinc (HZNC.NS) and Nayara Energy
The ministry has ordered plants to report weekly to the Central Electricity Authority detailing generation, captive consumption, power sales, available capacity and coal stocks
Separately, the ministry has extended an earlier emergency order requiring Tata Power's (TTPW.NS) imported coal-fired plant in Mundra, Gujarat, to operate at full capacity until December 31, citing the demand situation
Section 11 of the Electricity Act allows the government, under extraordinary circumstances, to direct generators to operate power stations in accordance with its instructions
items.raw_description: India has ordered more than 100 captive coal-fired power plants to operate at maximum capacity from October 1 through year-end to meet what it expects will be a rise in electricity demand.

items.title: OpenAIで再び隔離環境に不備、訓練中の自律型AIがネットにアクセス
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： OpenAIは、インターネットから遮断された安全な環境で訓練していたはずの自律型AIシステムがウェブに接続し、外部の第三者チャットボットにアクセスしていたことを明らかにした。

25日にOpenAIのウェブサイトに掲載されたブログ投稿によると、問題が発覚したのは1週間足らず前。同社の自律型AIシステムの一つが、外部ネットワークから隔離された「サンドボックス」と呼ばれる環境での訓練中に「隙間」を突き、インターネットに接続。第三者のチャットボットサービスに「フランスの首都はどこか」など、少なくとも20件の質問を送信した。サービス名は明らかにしていない。

同社によると、こうした隔離環境からの逸脱に伴うセキュリティー上のインシデントは7月以来だった。当時、社内テスト中に複数のモデルが連携してネットに接続し、AIプラットフォームのハギングフェイスのシステムに意図せず侵入した。

OpenAIは今回の問題について、「取り組みの次の段階で、どこに重点を置くべきかを示す重要な手掛かりとなる」と説明。サンドボックスの不備を解消するまで、最も高性能なモデルについて、ツールを使用する訓練を一時停止すると決めた。また、「当該モデルの訓練は再開しない」とした。

ここ数カ月、OpenAIやアンソロピック、グーグルのディープマインド、メタ・プラットフォームズが開発したAIモデルによる侵入が相次ぎ、サイバーセキュリティーやAIの安全性の専門家の間で懸念が広がっている。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（CEO）が2週間前に業界全体でAI開発のペースを落とすよう呼び掛けた際も、ハギングフェイスの一件を理由の一つに挙げていた。OpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOや実業家イーロン・マスク氏らは直ちに賛同を表明。AI規制強化の必要性を巡る世界的な議論に発展した。

OpenAIは、自律型AIシステムが以前ネットに接続した際に引き起こした問題をなお調査する中で、今回の不備を公表した。同社は25日、同社のAIモデルが訓練や評価の過程で、国勢調査局や米証券取引委員会（SEC）など米政府機関のウェブサイトにある公開情報にアクセスしていたことを認めた。

items.title: Another OpenAI sandbox fails, agentic AI system gains internet access
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The system reached a third-party chatbot during training, prompting OpenAI to pause tool-use training on its most capable models until the flaw was fixed ...
items.body: By Lynn Doan OpenAI said another agentic AI system that was being trained in what was supposed to be a secure, internet-free environment was able to gain access to the web to reach an external, third-party chatbot. The discovery was made less than a week ago, according to a blog post on OpenAI’s website on Friday. One of its agentic AI systems was being trained in a sandbox environment when it exploited a “gap” to reach the public internet. With that access, it sent at least 20 queries to an unnamed, third-party chatbot service, including “What is the capital of France,” the report showed.  OpenAI described the breakout as the first security incident of its kind since a combination of models gained internet access during internal testing and inadvertently breached the system of the AI platform Hugging Face in July.   “It gives us an important signal about where to focus the next phase of that work,” the AI developer said. The company said it decided after the latest incident to pause training with tool use on its most capable models until the sandbox flaw was resolved. “We will not resume training this particular model,” OpenAI added. Breaches by AI models developed OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Google’s DeepMind and Meta Platforms Inc. in recent months have alarmed cybersecurity and AI safety experts. The Hugging Face incident was among the reasons cited by Anthropic Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei when he called for an industrywide slowdown in AI development two weeks ago. His call, quickly endorsed by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Elon Musk and others, has touched off a global debate over the need for more AI regulation.  OpenAI disclosed the latest sandbox failure even while it’s still working to understand the disruption brought about by its agentic AI systems when they previously gained access to the internet. The company confirmed on Friday that its models accessed information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, during training and evaluation.  Just days ago, OpenAI disclosed that its models had disrupted an Australian government website earlier this year.  The most recent sandbox breach also exposed gaps in OpenAI’s operational processes. A “human reviewer” received an alert from an internal monitoring system and acknowledged it on Slack within three minutes, but the training run didn’t automatically stop as expected, the blog post showed. It took more than two hours for someone to manually stop the run, according to the report.  “It’s unfortunate that even after upping their security in the wake of Hugging Face, OpenAI’s models are still capable of gaining unauthorised internet access,” said Sydney Von Arx, founder of an AI safety nonprofit Nightingale. “The big question now is whether they will slap a Band-Aid on this and turn training back on ASAP versus if they’ll find the root cause of the issue and fix it.”

items.title: Japan's 11-year-old esports prodigy wins Asiad gold and rival's praise
items.author: Amlan Chakraborty
items.creator: Amlan Chakraborty
items.summary: Japan's 11-year-old esports prodigy Yuki Kurihara won the puzzle gold — and rich praise from his opponent — at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday.
items.body:
Japan's 11-year-old esports prodigy Yuki Kurihara won the puzzle gold — and rich praise from his opponent — at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday.
The bespectacled youngster barely broke a sweat as he cruised past South Korea's Kang Dong Shin 10-2 in Puyo Puyo Champions at the Aichi Sky Expo Hall, sounding like any regular kid only after his victory.
"I'm really happy. The gold medal is really beautiful, shiny and heavy," Yuki said.
"Also, the plush toy is super cute, and it's cool that it is gold-coloured too.
"In the final, I was able to play against the opponent I wanted to face the most, who was also very strong."
Kurihara had sailed through his preliminary matches to top Group A and carried that momentum into the knockout rounds, blanking Singapore's Justin Koh Mun June 5-0 and overpowering Thailand's Tanarak Wongkitikun 10-1 to storm into the final.
"Looking back at the match, it's a bit frustrating," silver medallist Kang said.
"It's obvious that my opponent was skilled and above my level, but towards the end I didn't get the Puyo colours I needed, which led to the loss, so that part feels a bit regrettable.
"I was being cautious because Kurihara is extremely good at making large chain reactions. His technical ability and accuracy are incredible.
"I'm going to eat something delicious today."
items.raw_description: Japan's 11-year-old esports prodigy Yuki Kurihara won the puzzle gold — and rich praise from his opponent — at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday.

items.title: El Salvador gana en Liga de Naciones Concacaf con doblete de Brayan Gil
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La selección de fútbol de El Salvador inició el viernes su participación en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf con un triunfo por 3-1 ante Martinica gracias a un doblete de Brayan Gil y otro tanto de Harold Osorio, quien dio las asistencias para los dos goles de Gil.
items.body:
La selección de fútbol de El Salvador inició el viernes su participación en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf con un triunfo por 3-1 ante Martinica gracias a un doblete de Brayan Gil y otro tanto de Harold Osorio, quien dio las asistencias para los dos goles de Gil.
En los otros partidos correspondientes al Grupo B de la Liga A, Jamaica venció a Guatemala por 3-2, mismo marcador con el que Surinam ganó como visitante a Honduras.
"Gracias a Dios que nos permitió esta victoria que le pudimos dar a esta gente que nos vino a apoyar, contento porque nos vamos con la victoria, la gente vio el esfuerzo de los compañeros y estamos para muchas cosas. Terminamos sufriendo un poquito, pero el trabajo se ve", dijo Gil a la transmisión oficial de la Concacaf.
En el partido disputado en el estadio Jorge “El Mágico” González, en San Salvador, ante unos 6.000 aficionados, la selección local mostró un juego ordenado desde el inicio y logró ponerse en ventaja al definir de zurda en el área tras controlar con el pecho un centro enviado por Osorio desde el sector izquierdo a los ocho minutos.
El delantero del Baltika Kaliningrad de Rusia anotó su doblete a los 18 minutos cuando definió de derecha ante la salida del portero tras recibir un largo pase de Osorio, quien metió el tercer gol a los 29 con un disparo cruzado dentro del área tras controlar con el pecho un pase de Mauricio Cerritos.
En la segunda parte, los dirigidos por el colombiano Hernán Darío "Bolillo" Gómez cedieron la iniciativa a sus rivales, que aprovecharon para descontar al minuto 51 a través de un tiro penal que anotó Janis Antiste.
En los minutos restantes del encuentro, Martinica llegó con cierto peligro al área de El Salvador, pero no pudo concretar las opciones que generó.
OTROS FRENTES En los otros partidos del Grupo B, Jamaica aprovechó su condición de local en el estadio Nacional de Kingston y sacó un agónico triunfo ante Guatemala por 3-2 gracias a los goles de Kasey Palmer, Rumarn Burrell y Renaldo Cephas a los 37, 53 y 94 minutos, respectivamente. Para la selección guatemalteca anotó Óscar Santis a los dos y 67 minutos.
En tanto, en el encuentro disputado en el estadio Nacional Chelato Uclés, en Tegucigalpa, Surinam venció por 3-2 como visitante a Honduras con tantos de Justin Lonwijk, Denzel Jubitana y Luis Palma en su propia portería a los 18, 39 y 66 minutos. Mientras que para Honduras anotaron Dereck Moncada y Bryan Rochez a los 20 y 23 minutos.
Al final del partido los aficionados hondureños abuchearon a su selección.
"Muy triste porque queríamos los tres puntos y ganar ante nuestra gente, tuvimos desatenciones que pagamos caro, pero faltan tres partidos y vamos con esa mentalidad de ganarlos con mucho trabajo, personalidad, disciplina y confianza. Esto solo lo podemos revertir con trabajo y confianza", dijo Rochez a la transmisión oficial de la Concacaf.
De esta manera, El Salvador se ubicó como líder del Grupo B con tres puntos, los mismos que registran Surinam y Jamaica, pero una mayor diferencia de goles. Honduras, Guatemala y Martinica se quedaron sin sumar.
En la segunda jornada del grupo, que se disputará el lunes, Jamaica será local ante Honduras, El Salvador visitará a Guatemala y Surinam enfrentará a Martinica.
El jueves, en actividad del Grupo A, Curazao se sobrepuso tras recibir tres goles y sacó un valioso triunfo por 4-3 como visitante ante Costa Rica. República Dominicana ganó a Nicaragua por 3-2, mismo marcador con el que Haití venció a Trinidad y Tobago.
Curazao, Haití y República Dominicana se ubicaron en los tres primeros lugares del sector con tres puntos cada uno.
En la segunda jornada del grupo, que se disputará el domingo, Costa Rica visitará a Haití, Curazao será local ante Nicaragua, y Trinidad y Tobago jugará ante República Dominicana.
Los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos avanzarán a los cuartos de final, donde se unirán a las selecciones de México, Estados Unidos, Canadá y Panamá, que llegaron directamente a esa instancia por ser las mejores clasificadas de la Concacaf.
Los ganadores de la fase de los cuartos de final clasificarán directamente a la Copa Oro del 2027.
La Liga de Naciones es una competencia de selecciones nacionales lanzada por la Concacaf en 2018 para garantizar que las 41 Asociaciones Miembro de Concacaf compitan regularmente en partidos oficiales entre las Copas Mundiales.
Estados Unidos la ganó en 2021, 2023 y 2024. México logró el título en 2025.

items.title: Reid Detmers has stellar outing as Angels defeat Mariners
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Reid Detmers pitched six scoreless innings of two-hit ball as the Los Angeles Angels defeated the host Seattle Mariners 7-5 Friday night.
items.body:
Reid Detmers pitched six scoreless innings of two-hit ball as the Los Angeles Angels defeated the host Seattle Mariners 7-5 Friday night.
Christian Moore and Zach Neto homered and Wade Meckler had four hits, including a double and triple, for the Angels (62-98). Los Angeles needs one more victory over the weekend to avoid the first 100-loss season in franchise history, which dates to 1961.
Dominic Canzone had three hits with a two-run homer for the Mariners (74-86), who scored all of their runs in the final two innings after falling behind 6-0.
The only hits Detmers (7-8) allowed were a one-out single by Canzone in the fourth inning and a leadoff single to rookie Michael Arroyo in the fifth. The left-hander walked two and struck out seven.
Mariners right-hander Bryce Miller (4-10) dropped his eighth straight decision since a 1-0 victory against the visiting Angels on July 2. He gave up five runs on six hits over six innings, with two walks and seven strikeouts.
The Angels opened the scoring in the first. With two outs, Meckler tripled to right and scored on a wild pitch.
They doubled their advantage in the fourth as Mike Trout drew a leadoff walk and advanced to third on Meckler's single to right. Vaughn Grissom lined a single to left to make it 2-0.
In the sixth, Meckler led off with a double to center and Grissom walked. With one out, Moore hit a three-run blast to left-center field to increase Los Angeles' lead to 5-0.
Neto went deep to left-center off Mariners reliever Eduard Bazardo with one out in the seventh. It was Neto's 27th homer, breaking his own franchise record for the most in a season by a shortstop.
Meckler came up later in the seventh needing a homer to hit for the cycle, but grounded out to second. He reached on an infield single in the ninth.
The Mariners got on the board in the eighth against reliever Sam Bachman. Pinch-hitter Lazaro Montes drew a one-out walk, Randy Arozarena and Canzone singled to load the bases and Julio Rodriguez was hit by a pitch to force in a run. Arroyo beat out an infield single to make it 6-2.
The Angels scored again in the ninth. Bryce Teodosio drew a one-out walk and came home on Neto's double to left-center.
Seattle's Weston Wilson drew a one-out walk in the bottom of the inning and scored on Arozarena's triple to right-center. Canzone went deep to left off Luke Murphy to cap the scoring.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Six big takeaways from a turbulent week of UN diplomacy
items.author: Antoni Slodkowski
items.creator: Antoni Slodkowski
items.summary: Limousines whisked world leaders away from the United Nations on Friday after a week of speeches, meetings and hallway diplomacy.
items.body:
Limousines whisked world leaders away from the United Nations on Friday after a week of speeches, meetings and hallway diplomacy.
While they reached no breakthroughs on the world's most intractable conflicts, talks on the Iran and Ukraine wars inched forward and global powers used the venue to debate AI risks with industry leaders.
Here are the big takeaways from scores of panels, hundreds of meetings, hours spent in lines and listening to speeches – and countless cups of coffee:
REBOOT OF IRAN DIPLOMACY The UN was probably most useful for facilitating the [USN:L1N45F09P TEXT:"first shuttle talks"] between American and Iranian officials since the collapse of a ceasefire in July. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators.
The efforts must continue, a senior Iranian official told Reuters, even as Iranian and American leaders exchanged sharp words at the General Assembly hall, with the US threatening to "annihilate" Iran and Iran accusing the US of a "bullying mentality."
The senior Iranian official said Tehran was reviewing Washington's response to its proposals, which include lifting a US naval blockade on Iranian ports and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
But no agreement appeared imminent. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio cautioned that a deal would involve hard work over time.
UKRAINE GRAIN AND ENERGY Rubio also held talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, after which he said Ukraine and Russia had both [USN:L1N45F0K5 TEXT:"voiced an interest"] in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy-related targets.
Ukraine and its allies are racing to secure limited agreements on energy infrastructure and Black Sea shipping before winter, fearing renewed Russian strikes on power and heating facilities.
But hours after Rubio spoke on Wednesday, Lavrov addressed the Security Council meeting on Ukraine, showing no indication Russia was prepared to engage on any subject. "Europe, whatever it thinks, just wants to get a pause, and it wants to use it to pump the Kyiv regime with weapons," Lavrov said.
AI STEALS CLIMATE'S SPOTLIGHT Climate change — a focus of UN discussions in recent years — was largely pushed aside by debate over artificial intelligence.
The festival of diplomacy coincided with an unprecedented outpouring of concern around AI after several safety breaches, and as top researchers warned it could destroy humanity.
The UN convened a Security Council meeting featuring OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, who made an appearance in person, as well as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. The industry leaders [USN:L6N45E0VV TEXT:"appealed"] for governments to work together to manage AI.
Underscoring the concerns, just as they spoke, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said that an AI agent developed by OpenAI infiltrated an Australian government website in June, accessing public and non-public files.
US President Donald Trump, who has dismissed AI risks as a "hoax" and "sick conspiracy," told the UN he "rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control" AI, describing it as amazing while promising the US would be careful.
SURPRISE ARRIVAL The biggest surprise arrival at the UN was Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez, who used her trip to hold [USN:L6N45E138 TEXT:"first in-person talks with Trump"] since coming to power after US forces grabbed then-President Nicolas Maduro in a dramatic nighttime raid.
The Venezuelan delegation's focus was on restructuring its billions of dollars in sovereign debt as it met US officials, multilateral lenders and companies.
Trump used his speech to the body dedicated to global peace to declare that in Venezuela: "to the victor belong the spoils," and called an oil deal the US signed with Caracas last month "perhaps the biggest deal ever made."
As Rodriguez and Trump met in New York, Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado [USN:L1N45F02O TEXT:"made three unsuccessful bids"] to return to her country.
SURPRISE ABSENCE The biggest surprise absence was the Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. The US [USN:L6N45F185 TEXT:"withheld his visa"] in a move that Sudanese and other sources said was linked to a US-backed ceasefire proposal that Khartoum has resisted.
The dispute, first reported by Reuters, threatened to deepen tensions between Washington and Sudan's army at a critical moment in the civil war, which the UN calls the world's largest humanitarian crisis.
Burhan had represented Sudan at the General Assembly since the coup. Another notable absentee was Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas, who addressed delegates by video and [USN:L8N45G1M5 TEXT:"condemned US curbs"] on the Palestinian mission's access to the UN.
UNCERTAIN FUTURE The cash-strapped United Nations may no longer be in "freefall," but it remains stuck in an [USN:L4N45906F TEXT:""open-ended crisis"]," International Crisis Group analyst Richard Gowan said. The organization is grappling with shrinking budgets, [USN:L4N45E1HB TEXT:"waning influence"] and mounting geopolitical conflicts.
Wars in Ukraine and Iran rage on, while Trump has denounced the 193-member body as bloated and globalist, slashed US funding and withdrawn from dozens of UN agencies.
As UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres received a standing ovation after his final General Assembly speech, a small group of politicians and former UN officials lobbied publicly and behind closed doors to succeed him. His second five-year term ends on December 31, leaving little time for the world's major powers to agree on a replacement.
The race, conducted according to an arcane multi-step process involving "straw polls," has no clear frontrunner, but former Costa Rican Vice President Rebeca Grynspan and Guyana's UN Ambassador Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett are [USN:T5N40K02L TEXT:"leading the pack"].
Whoever gets the world's most difficult job will inherit an organization buffeted by crises, low morale and declining political relevancy. That person, too, will welcome the leaders to New York for next year's summit.

items.title: Apax nears deal to buy Warburg's Odido stake, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Private equity group Apax is nearing a deal to buy Warburg Pincus out of their joint investment in Dutch telecoms group Odido, The Financial Times reported on Saturday.
items.body:
Private equity group Apax is nearing a deal to buy Warburg Pincus out of their joint investment in Dutch telecoms group Odido, The Financial Times reported on Saturday.
Here are some details:
The deal would value Odido at about €6.5 billion ($7.4 billion), the FT reported, citing people familiar with the matter
In February, Odido, owned by Apax and Warburg Pincus, [USN:L8N3Z51QP TEXT:"postponed"] plans for an initial public offering in Amsterdam after muted response from investors and concern over the extent of volatility in global equity markets
In the same week, the Dutch telecoms group suffered a [USN:L6N3Z816U TEXT:"cyberattack"] that exposed personal information from more than six million accounts
The owners have since received approaches for the business from suitors including Saudi Arabia state-backed telecoms group STC, the FT reported
Apax, Warburg, Odido and STC did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment outside regular business hours
Apax and Warburg [USN:L6N3YF0ZT TEXT:"acquired"] the business under its previous name T-Mobile Netherlands in 2021 at an enterprise value of €5.1 billion
($1 = 0.8779 euros)

items.title: 台湾高官「台湾への武器供給は米の重要な国益」、米中首脳会談受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ben Blanchard

[台北 ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Ben Blanchard

[台北 ２６日 ロイター] - 台湾外交部（外務省）の呉志中政務次長は２６日、台湾の自由を守るために米国が台湾に武器を供給し、世界中に台湾の半導体を供給することは、米国の国益にかなうとの見解を示した。

中国の習近平国家主席は２５日、トランプ米大統領との首脳会談を含めた３日間の訪米を終えた。だが、中国が自国領土と見なす台湾を含む多くの争点について大きな進展は示されなかった。

習氏は２４日、トランプ氏に対し、米国が台湾独立に反対するという「正しい立場」を堅持することを期待すると伝えた。

呉氏は２６日、台北で記者団に対し、台湾問題で譲歩することが果たして米国の国益に資するのかと問いかけた上で、「武器売却を継続し、台湾が中国の支配下に置かれることなく自衛できる十分な能力を持たせ、そして台湾の半導体産業が引き続き世界に貢献できるようにすることは米国の重要な国益だ」と述べた。

５月に北京で習氏と会談した後、台湾への一連の武器売却を保留すると述べたトランプ氏は、今回の首脳会談後、台湾問題や保留中の武器売却計画についてまだコメントを出していない。

呉氏は、台湾政府は米中首脳会談について米国側と継続的に連絡を取っていたと述べた。

習氏とトランプ氏が今年あと２回会談する見通しであることを踏まえ、武器売却に関する決定がさらに先送りされる可能性があるかとの記者の問いに対し、呉氏は、政府として注視していく必要があると述べた。

中国共産党機関紙の人民日報は２６日の論説記事で、台湾は「中国の核心的利益の核心であり、米中関係における最初の、決して越えてはならない一線」であると改めて強調した。

items.title: Steady Japan seek China inspiration to close gap in home Asiad
items.author: Irene Wang
items.creator: Irene Wang
items.summary: Japan have been "progressing steadily" near the halfway stage of the Asian Games, the host's head of mission said, but they are also drawing inspiration from behemoth China, who breached the 100-gold mark at the Aichi-Nagoya Games on Saturday.
items.body:
Japan have been "progressing steadily" near the halfway stage of the Asian Games, the host's head of mission said, but they are also drawing inspiration from behemoth China, who breached the 100-gold mark at the Aichi-Nagoya Games on Saturday.
The hosts remain on course to surpass their haul of 52 golds from the Hangzhou Games three years ago, even as China continue to set the benchmark with characteristic dominance.
"At this halfway point, we've been told by our strategy team that we are progressing steadily in terms of the number of medals, including gold medals, as well as our overall medal count," Japan's Kosei Inoue told a press conference.
"More than the medal count, what makes me really happy is that each athlete and each team set a goal of producing their best performance and then achieved it.
"We’ll keep supporting them so they can reach the goals they set for these Games and perform in a way that carries them forward to the next step."
With an eye on the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, Japan aim to maximise athlete performance in the second half of the Games, including by learning directly from China's success.
“I’ve seen the Chinese team excel and perform brilliantly," former Olympic judo champion Inoue said.
"For team Japan, that is a big stimulus and a learning opportunity, both for these Games and for the future of sport.
"There is a lot we can learn from them. We want to keep growing and keep working hard to catch up, even if only little by little.”

items.author: Alex Wickham, Chloe Chaplain and Joe Mayes

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝村上、菅野から2本塁打　岡本は3打点
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２５日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は２５日、各地で試合を行い、ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手はロッキーズ戦に「４番・一塁」で出場。相手先発の菅野智之投手から一回に３４号ソロ、七回に３５号ソロを放った。

村上はこの日、４打数３安打、３打点、１三振の内容で６─１での勝利に貢献した。菅野は６回２／３を投げて６安打、無四球、５三振、４失点で１２敗目（１２勝）を喫した。

ブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手はレッズ戦に「５番・三塁」で出場し、２本の適時二塁打を放つなど３打数２安打、３打点、１四球と活躍。チームは６─５で勝利した。

ドジャースの大谷翔平選手はジャイアンツ戦に「１番・指名打者」で先発し、４打数無安打、３三振だった。同僚の佐々木朗希投手は八回に２番手として登板し、１回を投げて無安打、２三振、無失点でホールドをマーク。先発したタリク・スクバル投手が７回を３安打、無四球、１０三振と好投したドジャースは２─０で勝利し、連敗を２で止めた。

カブスの鈴木誠也外野手は３─４で敗れたレッドソックスとのダブルヘッダー第１試合に「２番・右翼」で出場し、４打数無安打、１四球、２三振。０─２で敗れた第２試合も「２番・右翼」で出場し、３打数２安打、１四球、１三振だった。

items.title: Diamondbacks slice wild-card deficit with blowout of Padres
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Lars Nootbaar homered on the game's first pitch Friday night and Nolan Arenado added his 30th homer as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks tightened the National League wild-card race with an 11-4 rout of the San Diego Padres.
items.body:
Lars Nootbaar homered on the game's first pitch Friday night and Nolan Arenado added his 30th homer as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks tightened the National League wild-card race with an 11-4 rout of the San Diego Padres.
Arizona (86-74) scored in six of the first seven innings to earn its sixth straight win and move within a game of Philadelphia (87-73) for the final NL wild-card spot with two games remaining. Should the teams finish with identical records, Arizona would win the tiebreaker based on a better intra-division record. The sides split their six meetings this year.
The Diamondbacks rapped out eight hits on Friday and worked eight walks from five San Diego pitchers.
Brandon Pfaadt (8-3) allowed nine hits and four runs in 7 2/3 innings to beat the Padres for the third time this year. He walked two and fanned seven. Casey Mize (6-10) absorbed the loss, giving up seven runs on seven hits and two walks with one strikeout in just four innings.
Despite the loss, San Diego (89-71) moved within a game of clinching home-field advantage in the NL wild-card round on Tuesday. The Padres are 1 1/2 games ahead of the Chicago Cubs, who were swept in a doubleheader at Boston, and two games up on Philadelphia.
The Padres were aiming to clinch home field, but Mize couldn't cope with the Arizona offense. After allowing Nootbaar's 403-foot blast to right-center, Mize was rocked for an RBI triple by Geraldo Perdomo and a sacrifice fly from Corbin Carroll to make it 3-0 before the first inning ended.
Jordan Lawlar upped the advantage to 4-0 in the top of the second by lofting a solo homer to right, his sixth. San Diego pulled two runs back in its half of the second via Luis Campusano's RBI groundout and Jake Cronenworth's run-scoring single.
Arenado belted a towering two-run shot in the third to restore a four-run lead, followed by Gabriel Moreno's RBI single to center in the fourth. Perdomo ripped a three-run double off Kyle Hart in the sixth for a 10-2 cushion.
Lawlar's double-play ball in the seventh finished the Arizona scoring. Cronenworth plated a run in the bottom of the seventh on a fielder's choice grounder and Sung-Mun Song singled home the Padres' last run in the eighth.
--Field Level Media

Trump has granted Ukraine licence to produce Patriot interceptor missiles, says Zelenskyy

Ukraine had been seeking more Patriot interceptors to defend against Russian ballistic missile strikes, but the Iran war had depleted US stockpiles.

Ashwin Shekhar

26 September, 2026 10:01 am IST

US President Donald Trump and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York | Reuters file

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-

New Delhi: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told reporters in an audio message Friday that US President Donald Trump agreed to grant Ukraine a licence to manufacture Patriot missiles, ending months of uncertainty over the deal.

“There are concrete agreements in place… At our last meeting, President Trump emphasised to me that, ‘Yes, I have made a final decision. Ukraine will receive licences for the production of Patriot missiles,’” Zelenskyy said.

The MIM-104 Patriot is a mobile surface-to-air missile system developed by US weapons maker Raytheon to intercept aircraft, cruise missiles and tactical ballistic missiles. Ukraine has faced a shortage of Patriot interceptors, which are among the few systems capable of reliably countering Russia’s ballistic missiles. The shortage began in February, when the US-Iran war diverted Patriot missiles away from Ukraine.

Show Full Article

The licence covers domestic production of Patriot interceptor missiles, not entire battery ecosystems like radar arrays or launching stations. Ukraine will continue to rely on the US and European allies for those components.

The initial commitment from the US came in Ankara, Turkey, on 8 July during the 81st NATO summit. Trump discussed allowing Ukraine to produce the missiles domestically in response to concerns over supply, telling Zelenskyy to “make them yourself”. Asked about US defence contractors, Trump acknowledged they had not yet been informed but added that “they’ll be thrilled”.

The position was reversed on 31 July at Camp David during a cabinet meeting. Asked about the agreement, Trump said: “We have not agreed to that… We’re talking about it, but it’s a hard thing to give away that kind of technology… Nobody else has that capacity. These weapons are incredible. We have to be very careful about letting somebody build them… those people you give the technology, they could someday turn on you.”

Days later, Trump reiterated his position during a press briefing in the Oval Office, saying the US also needed to replenish its own missile stocks and pointing to the volume of ammunition supplied to Ukraine under former President Joe Biden.

“We want missiles too. Biden gave him so much, Biden gave $300 billion worth of ammunition,” Trump said.

In August, Zelenskyy launched a media campaign highlighting Ukraine’s depleted air defences. By early September, the US administration’s position had shifted to a cautious “maybe”.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio had said negotiations were “still ongoing” but cautioned that even after approval, establishing new production capacity could take several years.

The deadlock was broken at the UN General Assembly in New York on Tuesday, when Trump and Zelenskyy held a 40-minute meeting. Zelenskyy secured final authorisation directly from Trump, bringing months of uncertainty over the Patriot production deal to an end.

(Edited by Chingkheinganbi Mayengbam)

items.title: Behind Tarik Skubal's dominant start, Dodgers shut out Giants
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Tarik Skubal warmed up for the postseason with seven dominant innings, Teoscar Hernandez and Andy Pages provided all the offense with home runs, and the Los Angeles Dodgers opened a three-game road series against the San Francisco Giants with a 2-0 victory Friday night.
items.body:
Tarik Skubal warmed up for the postseason with seven dominant innings, Teoscar Hernandez and Andy Pages provided all the offense with home runs, and the Los Angeles Dodgers opened a three-game road series against the San Francisco Giants with a 2-0 victory Friday night.
Making his 10th start since joining the two-time defending champs at the trade deadline, Skubal (12-7) allowed just three singles and no walks in winning his fourth consecutive start. He struck out 10, reaching double figures for the fourth time this season.
The Dodgers (98-62), who have clinched the National League West title and the No. 2 seed in the upcoming NL playoffs, provided the left-hander all the run support he would need in the second inning against Giants starter Yunior Marte (0-2).
After the right-hander had escaped a two-on, two-out jam in the first, Hernandez launched the rookie's first pitch of the second inning into the left field bleachers for his 16th home run of the season.
After Max Muncy lined out to right field Pages followed Hernandez's flight pattern, reaching the left field seats with his 22nd home run of the year and a 2-0 lead.
In his third big-league start, Marte was able to finish five innings with no further damage, leaving after allowing just the two runs and six hits. He walked one and struck out four.
Giants relievers Sam Hentges, Joel Kuhnel, Dylan Smith and Tristan Beck kept the hosts close with an inning of shutout relief apiece.
But the San Francisco offense couldn't fire against Skubal and relievers Roki Sasaki and Tanner Scott. The trio combined to retire 20 of the final 21 Giants batters after Scott Bandura's one-out single in the third.
Scott was credited with his 24th save after throwing a two-strikeout ninth, ending LA's two-game losing streak.
The shutout win was the Dodgers' 14th of the season and the first for Skubal since moving west from Detroit.
Will Smith had three hits and Pages a pair for the Dodgers, who out-hit the Giants 7-3. Every hit in the game other than the home runs was a single.
Victor Bericoto, who was thrown out trying to stretch a single into a double in the first inning, Bandura in the third and Bo Davidson in the seventh got the only hits for the Giants (65-95), who lost their third straight overall and their sixth in a row to the rival Dodgers.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 米ディーゼル輸出禁止は見送りへ、ホワイトハウスが示唆－上院議員
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ政権が米国産ディーゼル燃料の輸出を禁止することはないと、ホワイトハウスは確約した。共和党のクルーズ上院議員が25日遅く、石油精製業界の幹部に伝えた。

協議の非公開を理由に匿名を条件に語った複数の関係者が明らかにした。トランプ政権はディーゼル燃料価格の記録的な高騰を受け、価格を引き下げる方策を検討している。

トランプ大統領は今週、ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止を検討するよう側近に指示したと明らかにしていた。小売価格が今週初めに初めて1ガロン当たり6.53ドルに達したことを受け、農業州の議員らが価格抑制に向けて輸出制限を求めていた。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、大統領が燃料価格の下落を望んでおり、あらゆる選択肢を検討していると説明した。クルーズ氏の広報担当者と、会議を主催した米燃料石油化学製造業者協会（AFPM）は、いずれもコメント要請に返答していない。

輸出禁止を見送るとの説明は、トランプ氏の主要側近の一部が数カ月にわたり示してきた見解と一致する。側近らは、ディーゼル燃料の輸出規制は最終的に弊害のほうが大きくなると繰り返し警告してきた。

ただ、トランプ氏は時に予測の難しい行動を取り、主要側近の全面的な賛同がないまま異例の政策を採用することもある。最終的な判断を下すのは大統領だ。

関係者によると、クルーズ議員はホワイトハウスから確約を得たと説明したが、大統領本人から得たとは述べていない。誰が輸出禁止を否定したのか、同議員は詳しくは明かさなかったという。

トランプ氏も政権当局者も、具体的な対応策を決定していない。短期間のディーゼル燃料輸出禁止が経済に与える影響の分析を続ける一方、価格抑制に向けた他の措置も検討している。浮上している案の一つが、通常は公道以外での使用に限られる赤色ディーゼルについて、利用制限を緩和することだ。

農業従事者などが公道以外で使うレッドディーゼルは非課税のため、利用制限の緩和は、1ガロン当たり約24セントの連邦税を含む一部のディーゼル燃料税を事実上停止することになる。この案が実現すれば、農業従事者やトラック運送業者などの燃料費負担が軽減される。

items.title: サウジ・パキスタン・トルコ、各軍最高司令官が協力強化巡り協議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビア国防省およびパキスタン軍の声明によると、サウジ、パキスタン、トルコの各軍最高司令官は２５日、サウジの首都リヤドで開催された会合で、情報共有、軍事協力、および能力統合の強化について協議した。

声明によると、各国の国防軍司令官および参謀総長は、サウジアラビアが直面する安全保障情勢と脅威について検討し、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による聖地メッカやサウジの民間・経済インフラを標的とした攻撃を非難した。

サウジアラビア、パキスタン、トルコは先月、集団的抑止力と軍事協力の強化を目的とする「メッカ共同防衛協定」に署名した。協定では、３カ国のいずれかに対する武力攻撃は３カ国全てに対する攻撃と見なされると定めている。

items.title: Thai capital Bangkok declared disaster zone amid flooding
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bangkok's governor on Saturday declared Thailand's capital city a disaster-affected zone after residents woke to widespread flooding with some roads inundated, and the prospect of more rain.
items.body:
Bangkok's governor on Saturday declared Thailand's capital city a disaster-affected zone after residents woke to widespread flooding with some roads inundated, and the prospect of more rain.
Here are some details:
Bangkok has experienced more than 24 hours of continuous rainfall, exceeding 150 mm (5.91 inches) in some parts of the city, with the weather agency forecasting thunder storms and heavy to very heavy rain over the weekend
Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said the situation "poses a risk to people's lives ... as well as damage to public and private property"
The government has issued an emergency advisory for people living near canals to move possessions to higher ground
Videos posted on social media showed cars inundated with water and emergency services providing assistance
The Bangkok City Administration said it has opened a shelter for evacuees

items.title: Angel Martinez's 4 RBIs help Guardians stay atop AL Central
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Angel Martinez recorded two of his four RBIs with a double during an eventful ninth inning, in which the AL Central-leading Cleveland Guardians drew six walks and scored five times, to win 12-9 over the host Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
items.body:
Angel Martinez recorded two of his four RBIs with a double during an eventful ninth inning, in which the AL Central-leading Cleveland Guardians drew six walks and scored five times, to win 12-9 over the host Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
The Royals' Nate Pearson (2-4) walked four batters in the ninth, including Jose Ramirez with the bases loaded and two out to break a 7-7 tie. Nolan Hoffman then came on and issued consecutive walks to Chase DeLauter and Petey Halpin to make it 10-7.
The Guardians broke things open with Martinez's two-run double and held on to maintain a one-game division lead over the Chicago White Sox (83-77), who defeated the Colorado Rockies 6-1.
Postseason-bound Cleveland (84-76), which overcame four runs, five hits and four walks allowed over 3 1/3 innings by Gavin Williams, took advantage of 13 walks issued by the Royals to win for the eighth time in nine games.
Kansas City trailed 7-5 in the eighth, when Carter Jensen clubbed his second two-run homer of the night, this time off Hunter Gaddis (6-3). Jac Caglianone had three hits with two RBIs and Salvador Perez added a two-run homer in the ninth for Kansas City (68-92), which is mired in a 6-17 stretch.
The Royals' Noah Cameron allowed seven runs -- six earned -- and seven hits with four walks over five innings.
Cleveland's Steven Kwan opened the game with a walk, then Ramirez reached on third baseman Maikel Garcia's fielding error. Following a one-out walk to Adell, Martinez grounded a single into left field, scoring two.
However, the Royals got a run back in the bottom of the frame. With one out, Bobby Witt Jr. singled, then scored on Caglianone's double off the left-field wall.
The Guardians answered with Austin Hedges' home run. However, Jensen, with a man on, tied things when he lined Williams' pitch into the right-field seats.
Cleveland regained the lead in the fourth via Ramirez's sacrifice fly.
The Royals earned their first lead in the bottom of the fourth. John Rave walked and advanced on Kyle Isbel's sacrifice bunt. After Williams exited and Tim Herrin came on for Cleveland, Rave stole third and scored via Jensen's flyout. Witt then singled, stole second and scored on Caglianone's hit to right field.
Cleveland, though, scored three times in the fifth, highlighted by David Fry's two-run home run.
--Field Level Media

items.body: ［バクー　２５日　ロイター］　 - 自動車レースＦ１の第１５戦、アゼルバイジャン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２５日、バクーで予選を行い、ジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）が今季５回目のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。 　ラッセルは１分４２秒５２６をマークし、２番手となったシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）に０秒８３７の大差をつけた。通算１２回目のＰＰで、６月末のオーストリアＧＰ以来となった。 　３番手はオスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア、マクラーレン）、手首の負傷による３戦の欠場から復帰したアイザック・ハジャー（フランス、レッドブル）が４番手に入った。 　個人総合争いで首位を独走するキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は第１コーナー内側のバリアに接触し、サスペンションを破損して１６番手に終わった。 　バクー市街地コースでは過去９戦で７人の異なる勝者が誕生しており、ＰＰからの優勝は３回にとどまっている。

items.title: Home hero Yamashita claims men's marathon gold in rainy Nagoya
items.author: Ian Ransom
items.creator: Ian Ransom
items.summary: Japan's Ichitaka Yamashita bided his time before surging to a commanding Asian Games marathon gold on Saturday, thrilling home fans lining the streets on a wet morning in Nagoya before Shitaye Eshete rolled back the years to win the women's race for Bahrain.
items.body:
Japan's Ichitaka Yamashita bided his time before surging to a commanding Asian Games marathon gold on Saturday, thrilling home fans lining the streets on a wet morning in Nagoya before Shitaye Eshete rolled back the years to win the women's race for Bahrain.
Nagasaki native Yamashita delivered Japan its seventh men's marathon title at the Games after allowing his rivals to do the hard work at the front before a decisive move.
Part of a six-man breakaway at the halfway mark, Yamashita stayed tucked behind North Korea's Hangzhou silver medallist Han Il Ryong and India's Sawan Barwal as they set the pace with 10 km remaining.
As Han and Barwal began to fade, Yamashita struck and powered clear to the finish at the Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in 2 hours, 10 minutes and 49 seconds, 48 seconds clear of Barwal, who posted a personal best.
"While the runners from China and India were taking turns leading the pack, I was hardly doing any of the leading myself. So I felt a bit apologetic," Yamashita said.
China's Feng Peiyou produced a late burst to snatch bronze from Han.
Japan threatened a sweep of the marathon titles when Mikuni Yada challenged in the women's race despite a tumble on the track after clashing with another runner.
But 36-year-old mother-of-three Eshete proved too strong and claimed gold 16 years after her 10,000 metres bronze at Guangzhou.
China's Cuomu Ciren finished narrowly behind the Bahraini for silver, with Yada taking bronze.
"Maybe it is the time to stop. I am 36 years old," said Eshete.
"But my target for my last competition is the (2027) world championships ... I have three babies and my second, he said, ‘Mama, don’t run’. He wants me at home. But now he will be very happy."

items.title: トランプ氏がホルムズ海峡開放案拒否と報道、イランは正式回答待ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Menna AlaaElDin　Parisa Hafezi

[カイロ／国連 ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Menna AlaaElDin　Parisa Hafezi

[カイロ／国連 ２６日 ロイター] - 米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）によると、トランプ米大統領はイランが提示したホルムズ海峡開放に向けた７日間の計画を拒否した。一方、イランはこの提案への米国からの正式な回答を待っている。

イランのアラグチ外相は今週、イランは米国にレバノンを含む全ての戦線で敵対行為の停止や、イラン港湾の封鎖解除、イラン資産凍結の解除を求めており、７日間でこれらの条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡を開放すると表明した。

提案の詳細はカタールの仲介者を通じて米国側に伝達済みだとし、「必要な条件が満たされれば、ホルムズ海峡は開放され、７日以内に通常の海上航路が回復するだろう。選択は今、米国側にある」と語った。また、米国が合意すれば、両国は「相互に合意した議題」について、より広範な協議を開始できると述べた。

ただ、イラン政府の高官は２５日、米国がイランの提案を受け入れたとしても、核開発計画を巡っては一切譲歩しない姿勢を示した。

匿名を条件に語った米当局者は先に、仲介者を通じたイランとの協議を「前向きかつ建設的」と評していた。

だが、ＷＳＪによると、トランプ氏はイランが自身の要求に応じることに内心懐疑的であり、側近らに対し、１１月の中間選挙後にイランへの空爆を再開する見通しだと語ったという。

イランはホルムズ海峡を巡り、敵対するサウジアラビアとも協議を行っている。

イラン外務省は２６日、アラグチ外相がサウジ外相のファイサル・ビン・ファルハン王子に対し、ホルムズ海峡における安全な航路に関するイランとオマーンの合意について説明したと発表した。

items.title: Report: Stephen Curry, Warriors agree on 2-year, $116M extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The deal, according to the report, includes a player option for the 2028-29 season.
items.body:
The Golden State Warriors and Stephen Curry agreed to a two-year, $116 million extension, ESPN reported Friday night.
The deal, according to the report, includes a player option for the 2028-29 season.
ESPN also reported that Curry will receive $20 million less than what he could have maxed out at to give the Warriors more salary-cap space for next offseason. According to the report, Curry and the team had been working on several contract ideas once he became eligible for a two-year, $136.7 million max deal in August.
If Curry plays through the 2028-29 campaign, it would be his 20th season, all with the Warriors.
The 38-year-old was limited to 43 games last season, with much of the time missed because of a lingering knee injury. Nonetheless, Curry averaged 26.6 points, 4.4 made 3-pointers and 11.3 attempted 3-pointers per game -- all above his career averages.
A 12-time All-Star drafted seventh overall out of Davidson in 2009, Curry has two scoring titles, two MVP awards and a Finals MVP award to go with four NBA championships. However, the Warriors are coming off a 37-45 season, their worst in a non-shortened season since going 36-46 in 2010-11.
Earlier this week, Curry said he wanted "no drama" with the contract talks, particularly with camp opening next Tuesday.
"The idea of getting back to work is exciting," Curry said Wednesday. "I feel like I've taken advantage of the offseason. I feel like there's no hesitation about where I'm at physically going in. ... But I'm excited about getting back to work."
Curry has career averages of 24.8 points, 4.0 made 3-pointers and 9.4 attempted per game. The latter two marks are NBA records, as is his career .912 free-throw percentage.
He also holds the NBA career marks for 3-pointers made (4,248) and attempted (10,073).
--Field Level Media

items.title: US seeks to expand passport records access for voter citizenship checks
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The State Department proposal would expand access to passport records for state and local officials and potentially some nonprofits to verify voter eligibility ...
items.body: By Zoe Tillman The US State Department is moving to give state and local officials, as well as potentially some nonprofit organisations, access to passport records to verify voters’ citizenship. The plan, laid out in a notice recently sent to key lawmakers on Capitol Hill, would add “voter eligibility” to the official list of “routine uses” for the State Department’s passport services records and provide access beyond government entities. Historically, uses of the data have primarily involved domestic and international government agencies and officials.  The expansion would dovetail with a controversial campaign by the Trump administration to tap into federal records to pursue election fraud investigations and aid states reviewing their voter rolls. It could give more entities access to sensitive data, which is subject to US privacy laws.  The State Department’s notice, a copy of which was obtained by Bloomberg News, doesn’t specify what nonprofit groups would be eligible to gain access. Based on bureaucratic timelines, the proposal wouldn’t take effect until after the Nov. 3 midterms, when Republicans are defending their slim majority in Congress.Broader PushStill, the changes could end up factoring in the administration’s broader push to play a bigger role in some aspects of elections. States, and not the federal government, are primarily in charge of running voting under the US Constitution.  Critics allege President Donald Trump is pressing baseless claims of widespread fraud and unlawfully asserting a larger federal role in elections. Trump and his allies have advocated for more aggressive federal efforts to root out noncitizen voting and fraud. Studies in the past have shown that such incidents are relatively rare.  State Department spokesperson Edgar Vasquez said in a statement that “President Trump has been unequivocal that this administration will protect the meaning and value of American citizenship. In order to uphold the highest degree of national security, it is basic common sense for the US government to use all the information available across agencies to protect election integrity. We are laser focused on delivering results for the American people.”  A number of conservative-leaning advocacy groups have backed the Trump administration’s “election integrity” policies and some have filed lawsuits accusing Democrat-led states of failing to clean up their voter rolls. The Justice Department notified a judge about the State Department’s plan earlier in the week in a pending fight over Trump’s March executive order directing federal agencies to play a larger role in voter verification. The department didn’t include a copy or the full text of the proposed language in the public court filing. Anna Baldwin, director of voting rights litigation at the Campaign Legal Center, one of the groups pursuing the litigation, said they’re concerned that the State Department’s proposal is “not just unprecedented but unlawful,” given the privacy protections for personal information that Americans share with federal agencies. “In the service of chasing this fiction of an epidemic of noncitizen voting, the administration is just determined to vacuum up data from wherever they can,” Baldwin said. “Here they’re talking about disclosing it to even nongovernmental entities.” In addition to passport-related services, the other approved uses for these records in the past have included verifying citizenship and identity for “social security benefits, employment applications, estate settlements, and federal and state law enforcement and counterterrorism purposes,” according to the existing guidelines.Trio of LawsuitsThe Justice Department’s notice earlier this week came in a trio of lawsuits in Washington federal court contesting key sections of Trump’s executive order, which included instructions to create a list of US citizens potentially eligible to vote using information from “relevant federal databases” to provide to state election offices as guidance.  Democratic Party leaders and organisations and voting rights advocates that sued have accused Trump and administration officials of unlawfully overstepping in an effort to assert greater federal control over elections and, in the short term, to help Republicans keep their majorities in Congress.  The judge had required the government to update the court on any “material factual developments” while the case is pending. Democracy Docket earlier reported the Justice Department’s notice. According to the Justice Department, the State Department will formally publish the proposal in the Federal Register 30 days after it notified the congressional committees. After that, the public will get another 30 days to submit comments.  Another part of Trump’s contested order related to the US Postal Service became the focus of intense legal wrangling in recent weeks. Federal judges blocked the postal agency from quickly implementing new restrictions on how it handles mail-in ballots in time for the November midterms, and the Supreme Court rebuffed the Justice Department’s request to immediately intervene. Separately, the US Supreme Court on Friday lifted a lower court block on its expansion of the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements, or SAVE, database to include information from the Social Security Administration as well as immigration records, and to allow states to run bulk searches.  A federal district judge in Washington had concluded that plan violated US privacy laws and put Americans at risk of having their voter registrations wrongly canceled.  Hours after the Supreme Court released its order, a federal judge in Maryland heard arguments in another lawsuit challenging how administration officials are seeking to carry out Trump’s March executive order and compile citizenship lists. With less than six weeks until the Nov. 3 midterms, states are within a 90-day window when federal law bars any program to “systematically” remove ineligible voters from their rolls, but election officials can still take steps to cancel registrations on an individualised basis. The case is DSCC v. Trump, 1:26-cv-01114, US District, District of Columbia (Washington).

items.title: OpenAI's models accessed US govt websites including US census and SEC data
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The company said its models accessed publicly available data from Census and SEC websites as it investigates incidents involving AI systems bypassing security controls ...
items.body: By Rachel Metz, Jeff Stone and Jake Bleiberg OpenAI’s artificial intelligence models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company’s agentic AI systems interacted with SEC.gov and Investor.gov, as well as publicly available data from Census.gov, people familiar with the situation said, asking not to be identified, discussing private matters. OpenAI separately confirmed that its models accessed publicly available information from the websites during training and evaluation of the technology. Earlier Friday, the company said it had notified “dozens” of organisations, including governments and universities, whose websites may have been hampered by visits from its AI models during evaluations of the technology.  OpenAI has said it’s carrying out an in-depth review of incidents of “misalignment” during training and testing, which will take months to complete. The company’s efforts to work out exactly what its AI agents have done underscore one of the biggest concerns among cybersecurity experts about these incidents: The systems have carried out these tasks largely without the companies that created them knowing in real time. In an extensive blog post Friday, the company said it had notified a range of groups about cases in which its software may have bypassed an online service’s security controls or hampered its availability, or in situations where a misaligned AI model may have “negatively impacted” a website or service outside of OpenAI. The company discovered these incidents while expanding a probe it began after its AI inadvertently hacked Hugging Face several months ago. OpenAI said the websites that were affected include ones run by governments, universities, public agencies, and other groups. In a statement, OpenAI spokesperson Liz Bourgeois said, “We’re conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity and notifying organisations when we identify potential impacts to their systems. We expect to make additional notifications as that work continues. Most of the activity we’ve reviewed so far involved routine research tasks, such as accessing public web content to answer questions.” Only days ago, OpenAI acknowledged that its AI models hacked an Australian government website earlier this year, marking one of the first known AI cyberattacks on a government database. The company said in a statement that the breach occurred while it was evaluating its models. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said this week that OpenAI’s technology had gained unauthorised access to a government website used for reporting healthcare statistics. The hack, on June 18, didn’t appear to compromise Australians’ personal information, he said.  OpenAI said a post on social network X on Friday that most of the actions it has reviewed involved AI models carrying out “mundane research tasks,” like getting answers to questions from websites. The company said it expects it to take months to finish its review. In a post on X Friday, OpenAI chief Sam Altman said the company has not worked as fast as it would like, but that it is balancing transparency with the need to find information in huge amounts of data in activity logs and then work with the companies that were impacted. “We are prioritising as best as we can based on severity, and adding resources,” Altman said. Hacks by models from OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Google’s DeepMind and Meta Platforms Inc. have resulted in widespread cybersecurity concerns for major companies. Cyber vendors typically provide products that monitor for known strains of malicious software, or detect and block anomalous behaviors. Traditional cyber software such as firewalls, email filters and incident response tools specialise in detecting those threats, and then alerting human staffers who isolate breached accounts or devices. AI models have proven to be significantly more advanced, sometimes finding previously unknown software vulnerabilities and then using multiple flaws at a time to breach a targeted organisation. Such compromises are harder to stop, and could provide malicious attackers with deep access to infected systems while remaining hidden from cybersecurity staffers.

items.title: Trump seeks to withhold $800 million in Congress-approved funds
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump sought on Friday to unilaterally withhold more than $800 million in spending on immigration, race and education that Congress has approved.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump sought on Friday to unilaterally withhold more than $800 million in spending on immigration, race and education that Congress has approved.
The move was the latest salvo in a fight between the Trump administration and Congress over control of the nation's spending.
"President Trump is committed to utilizing all possible tools to cut wasteful and harmful government spending that does not benefit American citizens," the White House said in a statement announcing the steps.
The statement outlined several programs, including some focused on refugee assistance, racial-minority business development and overseas conservation.
The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse, but the White House said the programs supported illegal immigration, stoked racial tensions and promoted alarmist approaches to the environment.
The White House is deploying a [USN:L6N3UL0M2 TEXT:"rarely used technique"] known as a "pocket rescission" that bypasses Congress.
Senator Susan Collins, who chairs the chamber's Appropriations Committee, described the step as "illegal."
"This is the most recent attempt by this Office of Management and Budget to undermine Congress’s Constitutional power of the purse," said Collins, a member of Trump's Republican Party fighting a tight race for reelection in Maine. "Any effort to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval is a clear violation of the law."
The Supreme Court last year declined to block Trump from using the same tactic to withhold $4.9 billion in foreign aid Congress had approved, while litigation continued.

items.title: White Sox SS Colson Montgomery sets single-season strikeout record
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chicago White Sox shortstop Colson Montgomery established a major league record Friday night when he struck out for the 224th time this season.
items.body:
Chicago White Sox shortstop Colson Montgomery established a major league record Friday night when he struck out for the 224th time this season.
Montgomery broke the previous single-season mark of 223 set by Mark Reynolds with the Arizona Diamondbacks in 2009.
The record came during the fifth inning against Colorado Rockies right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano. Montgomery worked the count full before watching a 93.3 mph fastball cross the middle of the plate for strike three.
The 24-year-old had matched Reynolds' record Thursday during Chicago's 9-1 victory over the Kansas City Royals, a win that also secured the White Sox's first postseason berth since 2021.
Strikeouts have been the downside of an otherwise productive power season for Montgomery.
After going 0-for-3 on Friday, he is batting .199 with 31 home runs and 87 RBIs over 151 games. He has a .285 on-base percentage and a .407 slugging percentage. His strikeout rate is 35.4%, the second-highest mark in the majors behind the 35.5% of teammate Munetaka Murakami.
Reynolds similarly offset his record-setting strikeout total with substantial power in 2009, when he belted 44 home runs and drove in 102 runs for Arizona. Reynolds had a .260 batting average and a .349 on-base percentage that year.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Twins batter Jacob deGrom, roll past Rangers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Luke Keaschall went 4-for-5 with a double, a triple and three RBIs, and the Minnesota Twins pulled away for a 10-2 win over the Texas Rangers on Friday night in Minneapolis.
items.body:
Luke Keaschall went 4-for-5 with a double, a triple and three RBIs, and the Minnesota Twins pulled away for a 10-2 win over the Texas Rangers on Friday night in Minneapolis.
Kody Clemens went 3-for-4 with a homer and three RBIs for Minnesota (76-84), which won the opener of its final three-game series. Royce Lewis had two RBIs, and Ryan Kreidler finished 1-for-2 with an RBI.
Corey Seager and Wyatt Langford had one RBI apiece for Texas (79-81), which nonetheless remained tied with Houston atop the American League West standings after the Astros (79-81) lost 6-5 to the Athletics later Friday.
Twins right-hander Joe Ryan (7-10) allowed two runs on four hits in six innings. He walked one and struck out eight.
Rangers right-hander Jacob deGrom (11-11) was battered for eight runs on eight hits in four innings. He walked three and struck out five, reaching 201 strikeouts for his first 200-strikeout season since 2019 with the New York Mets.
The matchup started out well for the Rangers. They scored the first two runs on Seager's RBI single to right and Langford's RBI groundout in the top of the first inning.
The Twins stormed back with six runs in the second to seize the lead for good.
Minnesota started the big inning by loading the bases with nobody out against deGrom. Lewis batted next and hit a two-run single to center to even the score at 2-all.
Two batters later, Kreidler reached on a bunt single that allowed Walker Jenkins to score from third. Keaschall followed with a two-run triple to right, and moments later Keaschall scored on a wild pitch to make it 6-2 in favor of the Twins.
Keaschall struck again two innings later. He hit an RBI double to drive in Kreidler, and Clemens followed two batters later with an RBI single to increase the lead to 8-2.
The blowout continued as the Twins tallied two more runs in the sixth. Keaschall hit a one-out single, and Clemens belted a two-run, 398-foot homer to left-center field.
The blast marked Clemens' 27th homer of the season, adding to his career high.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Brewers ride 4-run eighth to victory over Cardinals
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Brice Turang's tiebreaking two-run single keyed a four-run eighth inning as the Milwaukee Brewers earned an 8-4 victory over the visiting St. Louis Cardinals on Friday in the opener of the teams' final regular-season series.
items.body:
Brice Turang's tiebreaking two-run single keyed a four-run eighth inning as the Milwaukee Brewers earned an 8-4 victory over the visiting St. Louis Cardinals on Friday in the opener of the teams' final regular-season series.
Jackson Chourio singled to open the eighth off Luis Gastelum (5-4). Justin Bruihl took over on the mound and hit David Hamilton with a pitch. Bruihl threw wildly to first on Garrett Mitchell's bunt to load the bases, and Turang followed with his hit through the left side to put Milwaukee up 6-4.
Mitchell and Turang advanced on an error by reliever Cade Winquest, and William Contreras followed with an RBI single. Jake Bauers added a sacrifice fly to make it 8-4.
Abner Uribe (6-3) got the win with a scoreless eighth.
Milwaukee (101-59), which has won four consecutive National League Central titles, had previously clinched a first-round playoff bye and home-field advantage throughout the postseason. The Brewers have won three in a row and six out of seven.
Jordan Walker and Alec Burleson homered in a three-run seventh as St. Louis (77-83) rallied to it 4-all.
Held to one hit, Ivan Herrera's solo homer, through six innings by Milwaukee starter Robert Gasser, the Cardinals rallied against Bryse Wilson, who was activated off the injured list earlier Friday.
Walker opened the seventh with his 29th homer. Leo Bernal singled and Burleson tied it with a pinch-hit two-run blast, his 25th, off the right field foul pole.
Gasser retired the first 10 hitters he faced before allowing Herrera's 19th homer. The only other runner off Gasser came on Masyn Wynn's two-out walk in the fifth. Gasser fanned nine in his six innings.
The Brewers took a 1-0 lead in the first on Turang's RBI double.
After Herrera went deep in the fourth, Milwaukee answered in the bottom of the frame on Luis Lara's RBI fielder's choice to go up 2-1.
The Brewers added two runs in the fifth on Bauer's RBI single and Chourio's bases-loaded walk.
Brewers third baseman Joey Ortiz left the game in the eighth inning and appeared to be limping when he entered the dugout.
Cardinals starter Michael McGreevy permitted four runs on nine hits in 4 2/3 innings. He struck out two and walked two as St. Louis lost for the seventh time in nine games.
--Field Level Media
