items.title: Munetaka Murakami's 2 homers power White Sox past Rockies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Munetaka Murakami went 3-for-4 with two home runs and three RBIs and Sean Burke pitched effectively into the sixth inning, lifting the host Chicago White Sox to a 6-1 victory against the Colorado Rockies on Friday.
items.body:
Munetaka Murakami went 3-for-4 with two home runs and three RBIs and Sean Burke pitched effectively into the sixth inning, lifting the host Chicago White Sox to a 6-1 victory against the Colorado Rockies on Friday.
Chicago (83-77) remained one game behind the American League Central-leading Cleveland Guardians (84-76), who won 12-9 at Kansas City later Friday night.
The White Sox, who on Thursday clinched their first playoff berth since 2021, hold the head-to-head tiebreaker against the Guardians. Each team has two games to go.
Chicago won for the fifth time in six games.
Murakami connected in the first and seventh innings for the third multi-homer game of his rookie season.
The Rockies (57-103) were limited to four hits while losing their fifth game in a row and falling for the eighth time in the past nine. TJ Rumfield went 2-for-4 with a solo shot in the second inning.
Burke (11-7) won his third straight start, delivering 5 1/3 sharp innings. The right-hander allowed one run and four hits with one walk and seven strikeouts.
Rockies counterpart Tomoyuki Sugano (12-12) matched his season high by tossing 6 2/3 innings. He struck out five, walked none and permitted four runs and six hits, including two long balls off the bat of his Japanese countryman, Murakami.
Greeted by a standing ovation from a sellout Rate Field crowd, the White Sox responded with two first-inning runs to take early control. Miguel Vargas put Chicago ahead with an RBI sacrifice fly before Murakami drove a 2-2 pitch from Sugano over the right field wall for a solo home run.
The solo blast in the seventh gave Murakami a club-leading 35 home runs.
Sam Antonacci had three hits for Chicago while Braden Montgomery added two. Kyle Teel (two RBIs) and Murakami provided insurance with separate run-scoring singles in the eighth.
Chicago shortstop Colson Montgomery went 0-for-3. He was called out on strikes in the fifth inning, his 224th strikeout of the season, a major league single-season record. The old mark was set in 2009 by Arizona Diamondbacks infielder Mark Reynolds.
White Sox relievers Hagen Smith, Grant Taylor and Bryan Hudson combined to pitch 3 2/3 hitless innings with one walk and four strikeouts.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Senators acquire G Jonas Johansson from Lightning
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Ottawa Senators traded for Tampa Bay Lightning goaltender Jonas Johansson, the team announced Friday.
items.body:
The Ottawa Senators traded for Tampa Bay Lightning goaltender Jonas Johansson, the team announced Friday.
Johansson, who went 11-10-2 in net last season, was acquired for future considerations.
The 31-year-old spent the last three seasons as the backup to Andrei Vasilveskiy in Tampa Bay, appearing in 70 games with 65 starts. That stint resulted in a 3.28 goals-against average, including 3.29 goals against in 2025-26, when the Lightning finished second in the Atlantic Division.
A former third-round draft pick of the Buffalo Sabres, Johansson has played for Buffalo (2019-2021), the Colorado Avalanche (2021, 2022-23), the Florida Panthers (2022) and the Lightning.
After posting a .884 save percentage last year, he now has a career GAA of 3.30 and a career save percentage of .888.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Blue Jays rally with 4-run 7th to edge Reds
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kazuma Okamoto keyed a four-run seventh with a two-run double Friday night and the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the visiting Cincinnati Reds 6-5.
items.body:
Kazuma Okamoto keyed a four-run seventh with a two-run double Friday night and the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the visiting Cincinnati Reds 6-5.
Okamoto also had an RBI double in the first inning and has 92 RBIs this season to lead the Blue Jays (78-82), who took the opener of the three-game series with the Reds (74-86).
Mason Fluharty (7-1) pitched two-thirds of an inning to pick up the win. Louis Varland pitched a perfect ninth to earn his 35th save.
Eugenio Suarez hit a solo home run for the Reds. Elly De La Cruz stole his 30th base of the season to go with 30 homers.
Toronto scored twice against Nick Lodolo in the first. Charles McAdoo led off with a double to right and scored on Alejandro Kirk's double to center. Okamoto drove in the other run with a two-out double to left.
Suarez drove an 0-2 curveball down the middle from Toronto starter Jose Soriano to left for his 26th homer of the season with one out in the second.
Cincinnati added four runs in the third. Oswaldo Cabrera led off with a single and took second on Carlos Jorge's bunt hit to the pitcher. De La Cruz poked a two-run double to left and promptly stole third, becoming the fourth player in Reds history with a 30-homer, 30-steal season. The double was also his 30th. Sal Stewart hit an RBI single to right, took third on a single by Suarez and scored on a fielder's choice when Hector Rodriguez bounced back to Soriano.
Soriano allowed five runs, eight hits and no walks with two strikeouts in three innings.
Lodolo hit Nathan Lukes with a pitch to lead off the home sixth and was replaced by Luis Mey.
Lodolo allowed two runs, seven hits and two walks with three strikeouts in five-plus innings.
Toronto took the lead in the seventh. Mey (0-2) walked pinch hitter Andres Gimenez and Kirk. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. had an RBI single when the broken top half of his bat redirected the ball into right field. George Springer reached first on Cabrera's error on a grounder to shortstop. Okamoto hit a two-run double to left-center against Pierce Johnson and Lukes guided an RBI single to left.
Toronto's Tyler Rogers pitched around a leadoff single in the eighth.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Spencer Torkelson's huge night helps Tigers top Pirates
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Spencer Torkelson finished a single shy of the cycle and drove in three runs as the host Detroit Tigers held off the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in the opener of a three-game series on Friday night.
items.body:
Spencer Torkelson finished a single shy of the cycle and drove in three runs as the host Detroit Tigers held off the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in the opener of a three-game series on Friday night.
Eduardo Valencia reached base five times and scored three runs, while Dillon Dingler drove in two runs for Detroit (75-85).
Jackson Jobe (3-3) gave up two runs and three hits with eight strikeouts in 5 1/3 innings. Kenley Jansen pitched the ninth for his 22nd save.
Rafael Flores Jr. hit a three-run homer for Pittsburgh. Ryan O'Hearn supplied two hits, two runs and two RBIs. Starter Bubba Chandler (8-10) gave up six runs in 2 2/3 innings.
The Pirates (81-79) scored twice in the second inning. Oneil Cruz walked and stole second, then scored on O'Hearn's one-out single. With two down, Spencer Horwitz ripped a double to right to knock in O'Hearn.
The Tigers tied in the bottom of the inning. Valencia led off with the first of his three walks, and Brett Callahan hit a two-out single. They both scored when Torkelson hit a liner to right that eluded Jake Mangum, who attempted a diving catch. Torkelson wound up with his first triple of the year.
Detroit scored four runs in the third, all with two outs.
Kevin McGonigle walked, Valencia singled and Riley Greene walked to load the bases. Dingler drove in two runs with a single to left. After Callahan walked, Torkelson swung at Chandler's full-count pitch that bounced in the dirt. Torkelson reached first on the play as both Greene and Dingler scored on the wild pitch.
The Tigers tacked on a two-out run in the sixth to make it 7-2. Valencia drew a walk and Greene followed with a single. Dingler then hit a grounder that went through shortstop Konnor Griffin's legs for an error as Valencia scored.
Torkelson made it a six-run advantage leading off the seventh when he blasted a Wilber Dotel pitch over the left field wall.
The Pirates rallied against Andrew Sears in the eighth. Nick Gonzales and O'Hearn had RBI singles before Flores' three-run blast pulled them within one run at 8-7.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Nationals' win assures Mets of last-place finish in NL East
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Dylan Crews homered and scored three runs as the host Washington Nationals held off the New York Mets 7-6 on Friday to open the teams' final series of the season.
items.body:
Dylan Crews homered and scored three runs as the host Washington Nationals held off the New York Mets 7-6 on Friday to open the teams' final series of the season.
James Wood, Jacob Young and Daylen Lile had two hits each for Washington (76-84), which has won three straight. Wood also walked twice.
Nationals reliever Gus Varland (2-2) pitched 1 1/3 scoreless innings. Josiah Gray worked around a walk in the ninth for his first career save.
Bo Bichette and Carson Benge homered for the Mets (73-87), who dropped their second game in a row and are assured of finishing last in the National League East. New York hadn't finished at the bottom of the division since 2003.
Benge, who had two hits and walked twice, became the first Mets rookie to have a 20-homer, 20-steal season.
New York reliever Jonathan Pintaro (2-3) gave up three runs on two hits and a walk in one-third of an inning.
With Washington up 7-5, pinch hitter Brett Baty singled leading off the New York eighth. Benge singled him to third and Baty scored on Francisco Alvarez's sacrifice fly. After a groundout, Nationals reliever Jack Sinclair stranded Benge at second by striking out A.J. Ewing.
The Mets took a 1-0 lead in the first. Juan Soto singled with one out, Bichette walked and Mark Vientos lined a double to left, scoring Soto. Benge walked, but Alvarez grounded into an inning-ending double play.
Washington jumped on top in its half of the first. Wood singled and Brady House drew a one-out walk. Crews grounded into a force at second, leaving runners at first and third, and he stole second. CJ Abrams then singled off the wall in right, driving in both runners.
In the third, New York's Francisco Lindor and Soto singled. Bichette doubled to right to score Lindor, and Vientos hit a sacrifice fly, knocking in Soto to give the Mets a 3-2 lead.
The Nationals responded in the bottom of the third.
Andres Chaparro singled, went to second on a wild pitch by Pintaro and moved to third on House's double. Pintaro then unleashed two run-scoring wild pitches, giving the Nationals the lead. Crews walked, and Cionel Perez replaced Pintaro on the mound.
After another wild pitch, Abrams walked, and the runners executed a double steal. Crews scored on Lile's sacrifice fly to make it 5-3, and Abrams came home on a single by Keibert Ruiz.
New York pulled within 6-5 thanks to solo homers in the fifth by Bichette and Benge.
Crews went deep in the seventh.
Washington starter Andrew Alvarez gave up five runs on seven hits in 4 2/3 innings. New York opener Jefry Yan permitted two runs on three hits in 1 2/3 innings.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Arming Taiwan an important US interest, Taipei official says after Trump-Xi summit
items.author: Ben Blanchard
items.creator: Ben Blanchard
items.summary: The United States providing weapons to Taiwan to protect its freedom and provide semiconductors to the world is in the US national interest, a senior Taiwanese diplomat said on Saturday following a summit between the Chinese and US presidents.
items.body:
The United States providing weapons to Taiwan to protect its freedom and provide semiconductors to the world is in the US national interest, a senior Taiwanese diplomat said on Saturday following a summit between the Chinese and US presidents.
President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping ended a three-day [USN:L1N45H0FW TEXT:"summit"] on Friday with no big public breakthroughs on a host of contentious issues, including Taiwan which Beijing views as its own territory.
Xi told Trump in [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"Washington"] on Thursday that he hoped the US would adhere to the "correct position" of opposing Taiwan independence.
Speaking to reporters in Taipei, Deputy Foreign Minister Francois Wu asked whether making concessions on Taiwan would actually serve US interests.
Maintaining military sales, giving Taiwan sufficient capability to defend itself so it does not have to live under Chinese rule and "allowing Taiwan's semiconductor industry to continue contributing to the world, these are important US interests", Wu said.
Taiwan, whose government rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims, is the main producer of the advanced chips powering the AI revolution.
Trump, who in May after meeting Xi in Beijing said he was holding a package of arms sales to Taiwan in abeyance, has yet to make any comments on Taiwan following the Washington meeting or what he will do about the pending weapons package.
ARMS SALES Wang Hung-jen, a political science professor at Taiwan's National Cheng Kung University, said so far the outcome of the summit was better than had been expected, with Xi not apparently directly raising arms sales and Taiwan not the main focus.
"Looking at the results, many things we thought would be very bad didn't happen," he said.
Wu said the government had been in "continuous communication" with Washington about the summit.
The Trump administration in December approved an $11 billion arms sale to Taiwan, the largest ever, and the second one is worth even more - some $14 billion.
As to whether a decision on that could be delayed further, given Xi and Trump are expected to meet twice more this year at the APEC and G20 summits, Wu said the government had to pay close attention.
"Of course, if we can get guarantees, that would be best," he added. "I think what we can do right now is probably the maximum, which is to prepare as much as possible, communicate as much as possible, and make requests as much as possible."
David Perdue, the US ambassador to China, told CNBC on Friday that there has been no change in Taiwan policy by Trump, including on the 1979 Taiwan Relations Act which mandates arms sales to the island.
"We want peace across the strait. We don't want coercion. We don't support independence and we think that, you know, President Xi has gotten that message. President Trump has shown respect and listened to their side of that argument," Perdue said.
On Saturday, China's top newspaper, the People's Daily, reiterated in a commentary that Taiwan is "the core of China's core interests and the first unbreakable red line in China-US relations".

items.title: ShinyHunters hackers expanded attacks on Oracle's PeopleSoft, Google says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Google's cybersecurity unit said on Friday that hacking group ShinyHunters has renewed "mass exploitation" of a security flaw in Oracle's PeopleSoft software, after skirting defenses put up following attacks in the summer.
items.body:
Google's cybersecurity unit said on Friday that hacking group ShinyHunters has renewed "mass exploitation" of a security flaw in Oracle's PeopleSoft software, after skirting defenses put up following attacks in the summer.
Mandiant made the announcement in a threat intelligence report released days after ShinyHunters, which has claimed responsibility for several major data breaches, said it had [USN:L6N45H0U5 TEXT:"stolen FBI personnel data"].
The evolving nature of the attack is likely to ring alarm bells at organizations that rely on PeopleSoft for human resources and other critical functions, and heighten concerns about the vulnerability of even well-resourced institutions.
The unit of Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google said ShinyHunters exploited a bug in Oracle's (ORCL.N) PeopleSoft enterprise software in attacks from May 27 through June 9 that mainly affected universities.
Mandiant said the hackers adapted to defensive guidance published after the May-June attacks and targeted organizations that implemented web application firewall rules but did not apply an update that Oracle issued to patch the vulnerability.
It said, without identifying victims, that the latest attack affected dozens of systems globally in sectors as varied as higher education, technology, healthcare, agriculture, transportation and government.
ShinyHunters has said it accessed FBI data using a vulnerability in PeopleSoft. Reuters has not been able to corroborate the claim. Oracle did not respond to requests for comment.
In a statement issued Wednesday, the Federal Bureau of Investigation said it was "aggressively investigating" the reported breach.
ShinyHunters [USN:L6N45F0ZI TEXT:"exposed the names of personnel"] working in sensitive FBI units and acquired medical and psychiatric records, Reuters previously reported.

In a statement issued Wednesday, the Federal Bureau of Investigation said it was "aggressively investigating" the reported breach.
ShinyHunters exposed the names of personnel working in sensitive FBI units and acquired medical and psychiatric records, Reuters previously reported.

items.title: Iran awaits US move after WSJ report says Trump rejects peace plan
items.author: Menna Alaaeldin, Parisa Hafezi
items.creator: Menna Alaaeldin, Parisa Hafezi
items.summary: Iran on Saturday awaited an official US response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting in the wider Middle East war after the Wall Street Journal reported that US President Donald Trump had rejected the deal.
items.body:
Iran on Saturday awaited an official US response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting in the wider Middle East war after the Wall Street Journal reported that US President Donald Trump had rejected the deal.
Iran raised the diplomatic initiative at the United Nations General Assembly in New York, saying it had been transmitted to the Americans via Qatari mediators and could reopen the strategic waterway and put an end to hostilities in the region within seven days.
The Iranians also engaged their Saudi rivals regarding the strait, underscoring the stakes of a seven-month-old conflict that has disrupted oil flows through one of the world's most critical shipping lanes and taken a toll on the global economy.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi told reporters at the United Nations on Friday the deal would trigger a seven-day countdown to reopening the strait and a pause in regional fighting.
"If there is seriousness on the US side to come to a deal and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, everything is now prepared," Araqchi said.
If the US were to agree, the warring parties could start wider talks "on mutually agreed subjects," Araqchi said.
That could potentially include discussions of Iran's nuclear program. Trump has vowed that Tehran will never acquire a nuclear bomb, while a senior Iranian official told Reuters that [USN:L1N45H0JC TEXT:"Iran will show no flexibility"] over its nuclear program even if the United States accepts its peace deal.
Iran would grant no concessions over its rights, including enriching uranium or shipping its highly enriched uranium out of the country, the official said.
Even so, Iran had put forward a plan that would halt hostilities on all fronts, including Lebanon. The plan in turn would require the United States to lift its blockade on Iranian ports, release Iran’s frozen funds, and waive its oil sanctions, Araqchi said.
A US official, speaking on condition of anonymity, had previously called discussions through mediators "positive and constructive."
But Trump was privately skeptical that Iran would meet his demands, the Journal report said, and he told his staff that he sees a renewed bombing campaign as likely.
Reuters could not immediately confirm the Journal report.
SAUDI ALLIES UNITE Previous attempts at diplomacy have failed to end the war, which began on February 28 with US and Israeli attacks.
Since then the war has alternated between pauses and renewed strikes, killing thousands while degrading Iran's conventional forces and damaging Iran's already ailing economy.
Iran and its allies have retaliated by extending the conflict throughout the region. Iran, which controls the strait along with Oman, has struck US allies in the Gulf with drones and missiles while its Houthi allies in Yemen have targeted Saudi interests. Iranian-aligned militias in Iraq were blamed for a pipeline attack that temporarily took more Saudi oil off the market. All the while, Iranian-backed Hezbollah has been engaged with Israeli forces in Lebanon.
Araqchi briefed his Saudi counterpart Prince Faisal bin Farhan on the understanding between Iran and Oman regarding safe shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's foreign ministry said early Saturday.
The war's widening toll has also united Saudi Arabia's allies to shore up the kingdom's defenses.
The Saudi-backed, internationally recognized Yemeni government has come under assault from Iran-linked Houthi fighters, with Houthi missiles striking inside the kingdom.
Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early Saturday it intercepted two drones launched by the Houthis towards the Saudi capital Riyadh in addition to intercepting a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis toward Khamis Mushait.
The Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen and much of the north, have launched attacks against Saudi Arabia since declaring a naval blockade against Riyadh in July, with strikes targeting Saudi vessels in the Red Sea.
The attacks have targeted Saudi cities, energy infrastructure and shipping, adding to pressures on global oil supplies caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and putting at risk the main alternative Red Sea route for Gulf exports while traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked.
Defense officials of Turkey and Pakistan, both partners in a joint defense pact with Saudi Arabia, met in Riyadh on Friday to review the security situation and discuss intelligence cooperation, military coordination, and integrating forces, the Saudi defense ministry said in a statement.
The statement came a day after Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish foreign ministers met within the framework of the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement.
The violence in Yemen has prompted a new [USN:L6N45H0GY TEXT:"humanitarian crisis,"] the United Nations children's agency said on Friday, reporting a rise in acute malnutrition among children.
items.raw_description: Iran on Saturday awaited an official US response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting in the wider Middle East war after the Wall Street Journal reported that US President Donald Trump had rejected the deal.

items.title: Taylor Swift será la gran apuesta de Paramount para impulsar MTV: estrenará ‘Patient Zero’ en los VMAs
items.author: Hannah Miller
items.summary: La compañía espera aprovechar la popularidad de la cantante durante la ceremonia para revitalizar su canal de cable, que ha sufrido una fuerte caída de audiencia en las últimas dos décadas.
items.body: Bloomberg — Paramount Skydance Corp. ( PSKY ) aprovechará el “efecto Taylor Swift” para la gala de los Video Music Awards que se celebrará este domingo, mientras continúa trabajando en la renovación de su canal de cable MTV. La multimillonaria cantautora anunció este jueves que estrenará durante la gala de entrega de premios un videoclip que cuenta con un reparto estelar para su próximo sencillo, “Patient Zero” (Paciente cero). Ver más: Ni Bad Bunny ni k-pop: Taylor Swift se impone como la artista global más vendida del 2025 Además, recibirá un premio en reconocimiento a los artistas que también ejercen de directores, lo que la convertirá en la persona más galardonada en la historia del programa, informó la empresa en un comunicado. La popularidad de Swift ha contribuido a incrementar los índices de audiencia televisiva en diversos eventos, incluidos los partidos de la NFL (Liga Nacional de Fútbol Americano), en los que se la ha visto animando a su esposo Travis Kelce, ala cerrada de los Kansas City Chiefs. La boda de Swift con Kelce, que tuvo lugar en julio en el Madison Square Garden de Nueva York, fue objeto de una extensa cobertura mediática a pesar de que no se permitió la entrada a la prensa. Un impulso en los índices de audiencia gracias a la aparición de Swift podría ayudar a Paramount a revitalizar todavía más su cadena MTV de cara a su fusión prevista con Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. ( WBD ) Paramount han mantenido conversaciones con grandes empresas y figuras destacadas de la industria musical para adquirir una participación en la cadena, que en su día fue un pilar de la cultura pop, pero que ha experimentado un fuerte descenso en la audiencia durante las últimas dos décadas, tal y como informó Bloomberg News a inicios de este año. El año pasado, Paramount también transmitió los Video Music Awards por su cadena CBS, lo que provocó un aumento considerable de su audiencia. La ceremonia de este año continuará transmitiéndose por CBS, así como por MTV y el servicio de streaming Paramount+. Swift publicó en sus redes sociales un avance de 13 segundos en el que anunciaba el estreno del videoclip. Ella dirigió el video, en el que participan las estrellas de cine Colin Farrell y Dakota Johnson. Tiene previsto lanzar cuatro nuevas canciones este viernes como parte de una edición ampliada de su álbum “The Life of a Showgirl” , que publicó con Universal Music Group en 2025. items.title: Modelos de OpenAI accedieron a información pública del Censo y la SEC de EE.UU.
items.author: Jake Bleiberg, Rachel Metz, Jeff Stone
items.summary: OpenAI confirmó por separado que sus modelos accedieron a información pública de dichos sitios web durante el entrenamiento y la evaluación de la tecnología.
items.body: Bloomberg — Los modelos de inteligencia artificial de OpenAI accedieron a información disponible públicamente en sitios web del gobierno estadounidense, incluidos los de la Oficina del Censo y la Comisión de Bolsa y Valores. Según fuentes familiarizadas con la situación, que pidieron no ser identificadas por tratarse de asuntos privados, los sistemas de IA de la compañía interactuaron con SEC.gov e Investor.gov, así como con datos públicos de Census.gov. OpenAI confirmó por separado que sus modelos accedieron a información pública de dichos sitios web durante el entrenamiento y la evaluación de la tecnología. Ver más: Trump pide frenar acceso de Reino Unido a modelos de OpenAI y Anthropic: EE.UU. busca revisarlos primero El viernes por la mañana, la empresa afirmó que había notificado a “docenas” de organizaciones, entre ellas gobiernos y universidades, cuyos sitios web podrían haber visto afectado su funcionamiento por las visitas de sus modelos de IA durante las evaluaciones de la tecnología. OpenAI ha declarado que está llevando a cabo una revisión exhaustiva de los incidentes de “desalineación” durante el entrenamiento y las pruebas, la cual tardará meses en completarse. Los esfuerzos de la compañía por determinar con exactitud qué han hecho sus agentes de IA ponen de manifiesto una de las mayores preocupaciones de los expertos en ciberseguridad respecto a estos incidentes: los sistemas han realizado estas tareas en gran medida sin que las empresas que los crearon lo supieran en tiempo real. En una extensa entrada de blog publicada el viernes, la empresa afirmó que había notificado a diversos grupos los casos en los que su software podría haber eludido los controles de seguridad de un servicio en línea o haber mermado su disponibilidad, así como situaciones en las que un modelo de IA desalineado podría haber “afectado negativamente” a un sitio web o servicio ajeno a OpenAI. La empresa descubrió estos incidentes mientras ampliaba una investigación que había iniciado después de que su IA hackeara inadvertidamente Hugging Face hace varios meses. OpenAI señaló que entre los sitios web afectados se encuentran algunos gestionados por gobiernos, universidades, organismos públicos y otras entidades. En un comunicado, la portavoz de OpenAI, Liz Bourgeois, declaró: “Estamos llevando a cabo una revisión exhaustiva de la actividad de los modelos que no se ajustan a los estándares y notificando a las organizaciones cuando identificamos posibles impactos en sus sistemas. Prevemos realizar notificaciones adicionales a medida que avance este trabajo. La mayor parte de la actividad que hemos revisado hasta ahora consistió en tareas de investigación rutinarias, como acceder a contenido web público para responder preguntas”. Ver más: Un agente de OpenAI recibió un “no” y siguió adelante: así hackeo una web del Gobierno de Australia Hace solo unos días, OpenAI reconoció que sus modelos de IA piratearon un sitio web del Gobierno australiano a principios de este año, lo que supuso uno de los primeros ciberataques conocidos de IA contra una base de datos gubernamental. La empresa afirmó en un comunicado que la brecha se produjo mientras evaluaba sus modelos. El primer ministro australiano, Anthony Albanese, declaró esta semana que la tecnología de OpenAI había obtenido acceso no autorizado a un sitio web gubernamental utilizado para la publicación de estadísticas sanitarias. El ataque, ocurrido el 18 de junio, no parece haber puesto en peligro la información personal de los australianos, afirmó. OpenAI señaló el viernes en una publicación en la red social X que la mayoría de las acciones que ha revisado consistían en modelos de IA que realizaban “tareas de investigación rutinarias”, como obtener respuestas a preguntas de sitios web. La empresa indicó que prevé que le llevará meses completar su revisión. En una publicación en X el viernes, el CEO de OpenAI, Sam Altman, señaló que la empresa no ha trabajado tan rápido como le gustaría, pero que está buscando un equilibrio entre la transparencia y la necesidad de encontrar información en enormes cantidades de datos de los registros de actividad para, posteriormente, colaborar con las empresas afectadas. “Estamos priorizando en la medida de lo posible según la gravedad y destinando recursos adicionales”, dijo Altman. Los ataques informáticos perpetrados por modelos de OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, DeepMind de Google y Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ) han generado gran preocupación en materia de ciberseguridad entre las principales empresas. Los proveedores de ciberseguridad suelen ofrecer productos que monitorizan variantes conocidas de software malicioso o que detectan y bloquean comportamientos anómalos. El software de ciberseguridad tradicional, como los cortafuegos, los filtros de correo electrónico y las herramientas de respuesta a incidentes, se especializa en detectar estas amenazas y alertar al personal, que aísla las cuentas o dispositivos comprometidos. Ver más: OpenAI insta a EE.UU. a impulsar normas globales para desarrollar la IA de forma segura Los modelos de IA han demostrado ser significativamente más avanzados, detectando en ocasiones vulnerabilidades de software previamente desconocidas y utilizando múltiples fallos simultáneamente para infiltrarse en una organización. Estas intrusiones son más difíciles de detener y podrían proporcionar a los atacantes maliciosos un acceso profundo a los sistemas infectados, permaneciendo ocultos para el personal de ciberseguridad. items.title: ゴルフ＝アーカンソー選手権、西村が単独首位　渋野ら12位
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２５日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 米女子ゴルフのアーカンソー選手権は２５日、米アーカンソー州ロジャーズのピナクルＣＣ（パー７１）で第１ラウンドを行い、西村優菜が単独首位に立った。

西村は１番と２番で連続バーディーを奪うと、７番から３連続バーディー。後半は１７番でバーディーを奪い、最終１８番をイーグルで締めた。１イーグル、６バーディー、ノーボギーの８アンダー６３をマークした。

渋野日向子、竹田麗央、岩井明愛は５アンダー６６で１２位。畑岡奈紗と吉田優利は４アンダーで２６位、笹生優花は３アンダーで４３位につけた。

原英莉花、勝みなみ、西郷真央、馬場咲希は５８位。櫻井心那、岩井千怜、山下美夢有は８１位だった。

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝ペティット氏が93歳で死去、創成期のレジェンド
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２５日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のレジェンドで、バスケットボール殿堂入りしているボブ・ペティット氏が２３日に死去した。９３歳だった。

ペティット氏の家族は声明で、「父はメテリーの自宅で、とても安らかに息を引き取った。最高の父親であり、親切で謙虚、そして穏やかな心を持つ人だった。父と共に人生を歩むことができたのは私たちにとってこの上ない幸せであり、心から寂しく思う」と述べた。死因は公表されていない。

１９５４年のＮＢＡドラフトで全体２位指名されてホークス（当時はミルウォーキー・ホークス）に入団したペティット氏は、５５─５６シーズンにＮＢＡの初代ＭＶＰに輝き、５８─５９シーズンにも同賞を受賞。キャリアの１１シーズンすべてをホークスで過ごし、５７─５８シーズンにはファイナル優勝を経験した。

レギュラーシーズンで通算７９２試合に出場し、１試合平均２６．４得点、１６．２リバウンド、３．０アシストを記録。プレーオフでは通算８８試合に出場し、平均２５．５得点、１４．８リバウンドをマークした。また、６５年に３２歳で引退するまでＮＢＡオールスターに１１回選出され、同ＭＶＰを４度受賞した。

バスケットボール殿堂は声明で、「そのキャリアを通じてフォワードというポジションに革命をもたらし、洗練された技術を持つビッグマン、ボブ・ペティット氏の逝去を悼む。バスケットボール殿堂はこの偉大なレジェンドに敬意を表す」と述べた。

items.title: Eury Perez tosses first career complete game to blank Braves
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Eury Perez didn't allow a hit for five innings and pitched his first career complete game as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night.
items.body:
Eury Perez didn't allow a hit for five innings and pitched his first career complete game as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night.
Marlins rookie catcher Joe Mack broke a scoreless tie in the seventh inning with his 14th homer of the season.
Perez (8-11) set a career high in wins, one more than last year. He allowed just one hit and one walk, striking out eight. No Braves player reached second base.
Braves catcher Sean Murphy broke up Perez's no-hit bid with a 108-mph single on the first pitch of the sixth inning.
Grant Holmes (10-6), used in relief for just the second time this year, took the loss. He pitched four innings and allowed just three hits, including Mack's homer, three walks and one run.
One of the early highlights in this game was a diving stop by Marlins second baseman Jared Serna, who got to his feet in time to throw out Drake Baldwin at first.
Miami nearly scored in the fifth as Mack and Otto Lopez walked before Jakob Marsee's 387-foot drive was caught on the warning track by center fielder Michael Harris II, ending the inning.
The seventh inning featured more stellar defense for the Marlins. Shortstop Lopez threw out Harris on a 112-mph grounder, and third baseman Javier Sanoja made a diving stop to throw out Mauricio Dubon at first.
Mack put the Marlins in front in the seventh when he drove Holmes' curveball 428 feet to right for his 14th homer. The blast had an exit velocity of 108 mph.
Miami extended its lead in the eighth as Marsee tripled and scored on Heriberto Hernandez's single over second baseman Ozzie Albies as Atlanta was playing its infield in to try to keep Marsee from scoring. Then, with two outs in the inning, Griffin Conine added a solo homer to give Miami its 3-0 lead, and Perez did the rest, finishing with 105 pitches.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Freddy Peralta, Rays staff flummox Phillies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Freddy Peralta and four relievers combined on a four-hitter as the visiting Tampa Bay Rays topped the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Friday.
items.body:
Freddy Peralta and four relievers combined on a four-hitter as the visiting Tampa Bay Rays topped the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Friday.
Nick Fortes homered for Tampa Bay (97-63), which has already clinched the top seed in the American League playoffs but continued to pile on against a Philadelphia team with plenty to play for.
The Phillies (87-73) came in with a magic number of two to clinch a wild-card berth but now will have to sweat out at least one more day of the regular season after the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the San Diego Padres later Friday night. Arizona is now one game back of the Phillies for the third and final National League wild-card slot with two games to play.
Should the teams finish tied, the Diamondbacks would go to the playoffs having a better intra-divisional record after the clubs split their season series 3-3.
Peralta (10-11) gave up four hits -- all singles -- in 5 1/3 innings. He also yielded three walks, but the right-hander worked around the damage to get the best of Cristopher Sanchez (18-7). The Philadelphia lefty struck out 10 in seven innings, allowing two runs and five hits.
Tampa Bay scored a first-inning run against Sanchez, who recorded the first two outs before allowing singles to Junior Caminero and Ryan Vilade. Jonny DeLuca sent the next pitch into right field for an RBI single.
The Rays only needed one swing to double their lead in the second inning. Fortes launched an 0-1 sinker from Sanchez over the wall in left field for his sixth homer of the season.
The Phillies had a baserunner against Peralta in each of the first five innings, but they were unable to dent the scoreboard. In the sixth, Trea Turner and Bryce Harper singled against Peralta and moved into scoring position on a groundout.
Peralta then gave way to Cam Booser, who got Bryson Stott on a liner to second and Bryan De La Cruz on a liner to shortstop.
Kevin Kelly came on for the seventh and retired the Phillies in order. Cole Sulser logged the eighth and took care of the top three hitters in the Philadelphia lineup. Bryan Baker worked a perfect ninth to pick up his 41st save.
Tampa Bay outfielder Chandler Simpson exited after fouling a ball off his foot in the sixth.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Saudi coalition says it intercepts Houthi missiles, drones
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the kingdom.
items.body:
Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the kingdom.
The coalition said in posts on X that the missiles were headed towards Khamis Mushait and the drones towards the capital, Riyadh, adding that it was monitoring the missile threat and drones launched at the kingdom, without providing further details.
The Saudi civil defence had sent alerts overnight for Khamis Mushait and Abha but not for Riyadh.
The Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen and much of the north, have been [USN:L4N45908T TEXT:"launching attacks"] against Saudi Arabia since declaring a [USN:L1N43M00A TEXT:"naval blockade"] against Riyadh in July, with strikes targeting Saudi vessels in the Red Sea.
The attacks have targeted Saudi cities, energy infrastructure and shipping, adding to pressures on global oil supplies caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and putting at risk the main alternative Red Sea route for Gulf exports while traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked.
Hours earlier, the military chiefs of Saudi Arabia and defence allies Pakistan and Turkey reviewed threats facing Saudi Arabia at a meeting in the Saudi capital.
The three signed the Mecca [USN:L6N4440IT TEXT:"Joint Defense Agreement"] last month, saying they would regard an armed attack on any of them to be an attack on all. They said the pact aimed to strengthen collective deterrence and military cooperation.
The Saudi defence minister, Prince Khalid bin Salman, said early on Saturday that he had affirmed with Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir in Riyadh continued joint efforts to confront attacks against the kingdom in accordance with the pact.

items.summary: El Grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos offshore para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos, dijo el viernes el nuevo presidente del conglomerado, Joaquín Gutiérrez.
items.body:
El Grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos offshore para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos, dijo el viernes el nuevo presidente del conglomerado, Joaquín Gutiérrez.
Además, el directivo anunció que la petrolera, la empresa más grande del país sudamericano, buscará alianzas con Estados Unidos para ser incluido entre los países con condiciones favorables para hacer negocios.
Gutiérrez, un administrador de empresas que fue jefe de campaña del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, agregó que dirigirá el conglomerado energético con austeridad, al tiempo que fortalecerá el gobierno corporativo, los controles sobre el grupo y la seguridad de las operaciones.
"Avanzaremos en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementaremos fracking responsable y continuaremos explorando yacimientos offshore", dijo Gutiérrez durante el acto de su posesión, acompañado por De La Espriella.
Ecopetrol sufrió numerosas controversias durante la anterior administración, mientras fue presidida por Ricardo Roa, quien renunció a finales de julio y está vinculado a una investigación como presunto responsable del delito de violación de límites de gastos en la campaña electoral que llevó al poder al expresidente Gustavo Petro en 2022.
Roa también enfrenta otro proceso relacionado con posible tráfico de influencias por la compra de un apartamento a una persona a la que después le adjudicó un contrato en un proyecto de gas.
Además, el conglomerado fue foco de controversias por numerosos nombramientos de personas cercanas a Petro, por lo que actualmente surten investigaciones de organismos de control.
De La Espriella reiteró su interés por reiniciar la firma de nuevos contratos de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos ante la necesidad de incrementar las alicaídas reservas de crudo y gas del país.
"Las reservas hay que encontrarlas donde quiera que estén, ese es uno de los grandes desafíos que recibe hoy Joaquín Gutiérrez", dijo el mandatario. "Esas cifras (de reservas) obligan a actuar porque un país que renuncia torpemente a buscar sus recursos termina indefectiblemente obligado a comprárselos a otro país".
Ecopetrol, controlada en un 88,5% por el Estado colombiano, genera la mayor parte de la producción de petróleo del país y es propietaria de las dos principales refinerías, así como de la mayor parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos.

items.title: テニス＝世界1位シナーが中国ＯＰ欠場、膝負傷からの回復続く
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２５日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２５日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの世界ランキング１位、ヤニク・シナー（２５、イタリア）は２５日、膝の負傷からの回復が続いているため、中国オープン（ＯＰ）を欠場すると発表した。

シナーは７月のウィンブルドン選手権で四大大会通算５勝目を挙げて以降、試合に出場していない。その後はナショナルバンクＯＰを欠場し、シンシナティＯＰと全米ＯＰからも膝の負傷を理由に撤退した。

シナーはＳＮＳで「今年北京でプレーできないことを発表するのはとても残念。膝は自分が望む状態にはなく、まだ試合に出られる準備ができていない。できるだけ早くコートに戻れるよう、可能な限りのことをする」と述べた。

昨年の中国ＯＰでは決勝でラーナー・ティエン（米国）をストレートで下し、２０２３年に続く大会２勝目を挙げていた。

男子の中国ＯＰは９月３０日から１０月６日まで行われる。

items.title: トランプ氏がイランの7日間停戦案拒否、中間選挙後に攻撃再開も－WSJ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は、イランが提示した7日間の停戦案を拒否し、11月の米中間選挙後にイランへの攻撃を再開する考えを側近らに伝えた。米紙ウォールストリート・ジャーナル（WSJ）が、匿名の米当局者の話として報じた。

WSJによると、トランプ氏は自身の要求にイランが応じる意思があるのか懐疑的になっている。7カ月に及ぶ紛争の解決に向けて両国が断続的に進めてきた交渉は、幾度も決裂しており、今回のトランプ氏の拒否で打開への道筋が再び阻まれた。

両国は現在も、仲介者を通じてイランの核開発計画などを巡る交渉を続けている。ただ、米国はイラン側と仲介者に対し、トランプ氏には海上封鎖を解除する考えはないと伝えたという。

同紙によれば、トランプ氏の考えは今後数週間で変化する可能性もあり、中間選挙の結果にも左右され得る。トランプ氏がどの程度の規模の対イラン攻撃を検討しているかは確認できなかったとしている。

事情に詳しい関係者によると、米国とイランの交渉担当者は、イランがホルムズ海峡の通航を再開させ、米国がイランの港湾封鎖を解除する段階的な合意を模索していた。これは、両国が6月に交わした覚書に似た内容だった。当時の覚書は不安定ながらも停戦につながったが、数週間後には崩壊した。

イランのペゼシュキアン大統領はニューヨークで開かれた国連総会で演説し、制裁と米国による封鎖が続く限り、ホルムズ海峡での航行の自由は認めないと表明。経済発展を目的に核技術を開発する権利も放棄しないと述べた。

トランプ氏は今週、米当局者がニューヨークでイランの代表団と「非常に良い」協議を行ったと述べたが、発言は国連総会での演説とは対照的だった。トランプ氏は22日の演説で、イラン指導部が合意に応じなければ同国を壊滅させると、あらためて警告した。

原題：Trump Rejects Iran’s Seven-Day Ceasefire Proposal, WSJ Reports（抜粋）

items.title: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (glute) cleared for Week 3 return
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is ready to return from a glute injury and will start Sunday against the Washington Commanders.
items.body:
Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is ready to return from a glute injury and will start Sunday against the Washington Commanders.
Coach Mike Macdonald confirmed Friday that Darnold has been cleared after progressing from limited work Wednesday to full participation in each of the past two practices.
"Sam's gonna play, and he's ready to go," Macdonald said. "He's done a great job."
Darnold was injured on Seattle's opening possession of a 13-10 Week 1 victory over the New England Patriots. He completed 1 of 2 passes for 13 yards before leaving the game and later underwent testing that ruled out a more serious hip injury.
The 29-year-old acknowledged Thursday that the initial uncertainty left him concerned about both the remainder of his season and possible long-term effects.
Those fears eased considerably over the past two weeks.
"He looks great, so we're rolling," Macdonald said Friday. "It's a medical miracle he's back."
Drew Lock handled the quarterback duties after Darnold went down and started last week's 31-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals, helping the defending Super Bowl champions improve to 2-0.
Darnold is coming off his first season with Seattle, when he passed for 4,048 yards, 25 touchdowns and 14 interceptions while starting all 17 games. The Seahawks won a franchise-record 14 regular-season games before defeating New England 29-13 in Super Bowl LX.
While Seattle gets its quarterback back, its secondary will be short-handed in Washington.
Starting safeties Julian Love and Ty Okada have both been ruled out. Love sustained a calf injury during practice Thursday, while Okada remains sidelined by a hamstring issue.
--Field Level Media

items.title: サッカー＝ハーランド、イブラヒモビッチの北欧男子最多得点記録を更新
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［オスロ　２５日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［オスロ　２５日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのノルウェー代表ＦＷアーリング・ハーランド（２６）が２４日、欧州ネーションズリーグのデンマーク戦で２得点を挙げ、国際試合における北欧男子選手としての史上最多得点記録を更新した。

ハーランドは代表での５６試合で６４得点をマークし、１２２試合で６２得点を挙げた元スウェーデン代表ＦＷズラタン・イブラヒモビッチの記録を塗り替えた。また、２０１１年の引退までに国際試合で６２得点を記録した元ブラジル代表ＦＷロナウドの記録も上回った。

ハーランドは２０１９年のＡ代表デビュー後、代表戦で１試合平均１．１ゴールを超える驚異的なペースで得点を量産。ノルウェーを指揮するストーレ・ソルバッケン監督は３─２でデンマークを下した勝利後、「説明することができない。彼には学ぶことができない生まれ持った本能がある」とハーランドを称賛した。

また、代表で同僚のＭＦサンデル・ベルゲも、「信じられない。ハーランドがゴールを決めるのは日常茶飯事だから、彼がトップに立ったのは当然かもしれないが、やはり圧倒的な力強さを感じる」とエースを称えた。

items.title: South Africa open to more talks with US after visa dispute, minister says
items.author: Doyinsola Oladipo
items.creator: Doyinsola Oladipo
items.summary: South Africa remains open to talks with the US on areas of dispute, including rules for foreign investors on Black employment and ownership, although it was surprised by last week's US visa restrictions, South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said on Friday.
items.body:
South Africa remains open to talks with the US on areas of dispute, including rules for foreign investors on Black employment and ownership, although it was surprised by last week's US visa restrictions, South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said on Friday.
The two countries were discussing ways to accommodate new US entrants into South Africa's mining sector, among other matters, Lamola said, and were making progress when Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced curbs on visas for South Africans, citing concerns over its laws and policies. He did not specify who would be subject to the ban.
"South Africa remains open to engage with the U.S. administration on all the issues that they have put on the table," Lamola said in an interview on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.
"We are predictable and reliable partners, and we see the U.S. as an important strategic partner."
President Donald Trump's administration has [USN:L8N3RS0M7 TEXT:"criticized South Africa"] over a range of issues including actions aimed at addressing racial inequality, which he says hurt the African nation's white population.
While South Africa has [USN:L8N4580PB TEXT:"criticized the new visa restrictions"], Lamola said Pretoria did not want a “tit-for-tat war” with Washington over the issue, given the importance of the economic relationship, but said the current US administration was unpredictable.
"You can't be confident of anything with the current administration, and it's not only Pretoria. I think all countries of the world, the friends and foes of the US view it the same," he said.
Washington is also pressing Pretoria over its land reform policies and its genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice.
Lamola called Washington's resettlement program for white Afrikaners a "race-based" program and questioned their designation as refugees, saying some continued to visit South Africa after leaving. He said Pretoria, however, would neither stop nor interfere with South Africans who choose to participate.
On South Africa's genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice, Lamola said the case “has to have a life of its own” and must be decided by the court, with international law serving as an “equalizer amongst nations, big and small.”
After the announcement of visa restrictions on September 15, the US ambassador to South Africa said they were "only the first step in a series of escalatory measures" and that the time for endless dialogue had run its course.
"If you can't dialog and you want to declare that dialog has run its course, you are in the wrong profession — you are not a diplomat," said Lamola, adding that only Washington knows if the relationship will recover.

FAST

Sept 25 : OpenAI's models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
The company's agentic AI systems interacted with SEC.gov, Investor.gov and publicly available Census.gov data, the report said, citing people familiar with the situation.
Asked for comment, an OpenAI spokesperson said the company was "conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity and notifying organizations when we identify potential impacts to their systems. We expect to make additional notifications as that work continues."
The review has mostly found "routine research tasks," and "some involved government websites because our models often turn to them as authoritative sources of public information," the spokesperson said in a statement.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ゴルフ＝世界選抜が米国に5戦全勝、松山組も勝利　プレジデンツ杯
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２５日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 男子ゴルフの欧州を除く世界選抜と米国選抜による団体対抗戦、プレジデンツ・カップ（杯）は２５日、シカゴのメディナＣＣで第２日のラウンドを行い、一つのボールを２人が交互に打つフォアサムで世界選抜が５試合全てに勝利。通算７勝３敗として米国選抜からリードを奪った。

松山英樹、任成宰（韓国）組はラッセル・ヘンリー、ジェイコブ・ブリッジマン組に３アンド２で勝利した。

コリー・コナーズ、ニック・テーラー（ともにカナダ）組は世界ランキング１位のスコッティ・シェフラー、サム・バーンズ組を１アップで撃破した。

２６日は午前にホールごとに２人一組で良い方のスコアを採用するフォアボール、午後にフォアサムを実施。最終日の２７日はシングルスを行う。

items.title: OpenAI's models accessed public US Census, SEC data, Bloomberg News reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: OpenAI's models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
items.body:
OpenAI's models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
The company's agentic AI systems interacted with SEC.gov, Investor.gov and publicly available Census.gov data, the report said, citing people familiar with the situation.
Asked for comment, an OpenAI spokesperson said the company was "conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity and notifying organizations when we identify potential impacts to their systems. We expect to make additional notifications as that work continues."
The review has mostly found "routine research tasks," and "some involved government websites because our models often turn to them as authoritative sources of public information," the spokesperson said in a statement.

items.title: テニス＝欧州選抜が世界選抜にリード、アルカラス貢献　レーバー杯
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　２５日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ロンドン　２５日　ロイター］　 - 男子テニスの欧州選抜と世界選抜による対抗戦、レーバー・カップ（杯）は２５日、ロンドンで開幕し、欧州選抜が３─１とリードした。

シングルスではカスパー・ルード（ノルウェー）がフランシスコ・セルンドロ（アルゼンチン）を６─７、６─４、１０─８で下し、欧州選抜が先勝。ブランドン・ナカシマ（米国）がヤクブ・メンシク（チェコ）を６─１、３─６、１０─７で退けて世界選抜が追いついたが、レーバー杯初出場のラファエル・ホダル（スペイン）がアレクサンドル・ブブリク（カザフスタン）を６─２、６─３で破り、欧州選抜が再びリードした。

ダブルスでは世界ランキング３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）がメンシクと組み、ブブリク、テーラー・フリッツ（米国）組に６─４、６─４のストレート勝ちを収めた。

４カ月の負傷離脱から全米オープンで復帰し、今大会が復帰後２大会目となるアルカラスは「どこに行っても、どのコートでプレーしても楽しもうとしている。普段はダブルスをプレーしないが、楽しみながら自分のテニスを向上させるために使っている」と話した。

大会は３日間で行われ、欧州選抜と世界選抜がそれぞれ６選手で争う。各試合の勝利で、初日は１ポイント、２日目は２ポイント、最終日は３ポイントを獲得。先に１３ポイントに到達したチームが優勝する。

items.title: SKハイニックス傘下ソリダイム、2027年にも米IPOを検討－関係者
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： SKハイニックス傘下でNAND型フラッシュメモリーを手がける米ソリダイム（Solidigm）が、早ければ2027年にも米国での新規株式公開（IPO）を検討していることが分かった。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにした。

メモリー半導体で世界2位の韓国SKハイニックスは、ソリダイム上場に向けてアドバイザー候補の金融機関と協議している。情報が非公開であることを理由に、関係者は匿名を条件に語った。

一部の関係者によると、上場で企業価値は最大1000億ドル（約15兆7300億円）に達する可能性がある。検討は続いており、時期や評価額などは今後変わる可能性もあるという。

金融機関への打診や上場時期の詳細は、ロイター通信が関係者の話として先に報じていた。ソリダイムの広報担当者はコメントを控えた。

SKハイニックスは米インテルのフラッシュメモリー事業を買収した後、同事業の名称をソリダイムに変更した。ソリダイムのウェブサイトによると、データセンター向けのストレージ製品を主力とし、トランプ一組ほどの大きさで最大122テラバイトの容量を持つ製品もそろえる。

8月には、いわゆるネオクラウド（AIに特化したクラウド）業者の米コアウィーブに企業向けSSD（ソリッド・ステート・ドライブ）を供給する契約を発表した。コアウィーブのAIクラウド基盤を支えるストレージ容量を提供する見通しだ。ウェブサイトによると、ほかにもバスト・データやデル・テクノロジーズ、中国のテンセント（騰訊）などに製品を供給している。

本社は米カリフォルニア州にある。メキシコやカナダ、中国など世界13カ所に拠点を置き、従業員は2000人を超える。

原題：SK Hynix’s Solidigm Is Said to Weigh US IPO as Soon as 2027 (1)（抜粋）

items.title: サッカー＝フランス代表エムバペ、決勝点も膝負傷でメンバーから外れる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［コジャエリ（トルコ）　２５日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［コジャエリ（トルコ）　２５日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス代表ＦＷキリアン・エムバペが２５日に行われた欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）のトルコ戦で決勝点を挙げた直後に膝を負傷し、チームから離脱することになった。

フランスはリーグＡの１組でトルコとのアウェー戦に臨んだ。後半９分にミカエル・オリーズのアシストから先制点をマークした主将のエムバペだが、直後にけがのため治療を受け、一時ピッチに戻ったものの再び倒れ込み、プレー続行不可能により同１４分に交代した。

ジネディーヌ・ジダン監督は、フランス代表指揮官としての初陣を白星で飾った後、エムバペについて「残念ながら状況は良くない。彼は（クラブに）戻らなければならないだろう。リスクを冒すつもりはない。膝に腫れが見られる。楽観できる状態ではないため、無理はさせない」と語った。

フランス・サッカー連盟はエムバペが膝の腱を負傷したことにより、レアル・マドリード（スペイン）に戻ると発表した。

items.title: サッカー＝ベリンガム、イングランド男子年間最優秀選手に選出
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　２５日　ロイター］
items.body:
［ロンドン　２５日　ロイター］ -

イングランドサッカー協会（ＦＡ）は２５日、同国代表ＭＦジュード・ベリンガム（２３）を２季連続で男子年間最優秀選手に選出したことを発表した。

レアル・マドリード（スペイン）に所属するベリンガムは、２０２６年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）で７得点を記録。主要国際大会におけるイングランド男子代表の１大会最多得点記録を樹立し、同代表が１９６６年以来最高となる３位に入る原動力となった。

ベリンガムは「素晴らしい気分。再びファンに評価してもらえたことは大きな名誉」とコメント。「代表でプレーしている時に考えるようなことではないが、素晴らしい夏を過ごせたこと、そして母国のためにプレーできた名誉に、うれしい彩りを添えてくれる出来事だ」と喜んだ。

受賞者はイングランド代表の公式アプリを通じたサポーター投票で決定。ベリンガムはＷ杯決勝トーナメント２回戦のメキシコ戦と、準々決勝のノルウェー戦でそれぞれ２得点を挙げた。また、欧州選手として史上最年少で主要国際大会４大会出場を果たした。

主将ハリー・ケーンは代表で今季計１２得点を挙げ、自身最多に並ぶ数字で７季連続のチーム最多得点者となった。ケーンはこの記録について「安定感を示すもの」と述べ、チームメートやコーチ陣に感謝した。

items.title: SpaceX desplaza a York en contratos del ‘Golden Dome’ y aumenta la dependencia del Pentágono
items.author: Sana Pashankar
items.summary: El Pentágono ha adjudicado a SpaceX contratos clave del ‘Golden Dome’, mientras York y otros proveedores reciben acuerdos mucho menores. La situación reaviva el debate sobre la competencia en el secto ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La empresa de satélites York Space Systems Inc. comunicó a los inversores durante su oferta pública inicial de este año que conseguir una parte del proyecto de defensa antimisiles ‘Golden Dome’, valorado en US$185.000 millones, impulsaría su crecimiento. Entonces se topó de lleno con SpaceX ( SPCX ). En mayo, la empresa de Elon Musk se adjudicó un contrato de US$2.000 millones para una red de satélites militares destinados a la comunicación y el transporte de datos, como parte del proyecto ‘Golden Dome’. Meses más tarde, a York y a otras pocas empresas solo les quedaron contratos por valor de unos pocos millones de dólares. Ver más: Peso de SpaceX en el Nasdaq 100 subirá al 2,82% desde el lunes, más del doble de su nivel actual Según fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto, muchos de los requisitos —como la velocidad y la capacidad de producción— se adaptaron de forma tan específica al Starshield de SpaceX, la versión militarizada de su red Starlink, que algunas empresas ni siquiera se molestaron en presentar una oferta. Para York, que había basado su negocio en contratos como estos —parte de un proyecto cuyo alcance total probablemente superaría el billón de dólares—, el golpe provocó una caída en picado de sus acciones. En el conjunto del sector, la decisión avivó el temor de que el enfoque del Pentágono hacia SpaceX pudiera frenar el crecimiento de posibles competidores y agravar la dependencia de un único proveedor. “No debería darse el caso de que se decida de antemano que se desea adjudicar un contrato a una empresa concreta y, a continuación, se redacten todos los criterios para que eso suceda”, afirmó Dave Vorland, quien ocupó el cargo de subsecretario adjunto en funciones de política espacial y de defensa antimisiles en la Administración Biden. “Nos gustaría ver una base industrial que incluya a más de una empresa viable”. Mientras el Pentágono se apresura a poner en funcionamiento el ‘Golden Dome’ antes de que finalice el mandato de Trump en 2028, el énfasis en la rapidez ha contribuido a una mayor y más acentuada dependencia de SpaceX, según personas familiarizadas con el asunto. La empresa de Musk ha reducido drásticamente el coste de poner en órbita satélites gracias a su cohete estrella, el Falcon 9, y cuenta con la mayor red de satélites del mundo, Starlink. Además, fabrica internamente la mayoría de los componentes de su hardware y es capaz de producir satélites en serie a un ritmo que pocas empresas, si es que hay alguna, pueden igualar. Ver más: SpaceX analiza comprar datos de startups que fracasaron para entrenar sus modelos de IA Esto ha llevado a la Fuerza Espacial a diseñar contratos de varios miles de millones de dólares específicamente para la empresa, según afirman dichas fuentes, a pesar de la resistencia que encuentra por parte del Congreso y de la Oficina de Gestión y Presupuesto. Para el contrato de la red de comunicaciones de mayo, el Pentágono eligió los satélites Starshield a pesar de que incorporan un sistema de radio de última generación que las fuerzas estadounidenses y aliadas no utilizan de forma generalizada en la actualidad, una decisión que generó controversia dentro del Pentágono, según personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Los satélites de otros proveedores, entre ellos York y Northrop Grumman Corp. ( NOC ), son compatibles con los sistemas actuales. Un portavoz de la Fuerza Espacial afirmó que el servicio está comprometido con la competencia y con la creación de una base industrial viable, y que la necesidad de actuar con rapidez viene dictada por una amenaza en rápido crecimiento. SpaceX no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. La decisión del Departamento de Defensa en mayo fue, en parte, un intento de unificar otra red de comunicaciones gubernamental basada en Starshield, denominada originalmente MILNET, que también se enfrentaba a acusaciones de estar diseñada a medida para SpaceX. En una audiencia del Congreso celebrada en junio de 2025, el senador demócrata Chris Coons, de Delaware, afirmó que MILNET “se estaba adjudicando en exclusiva a SpaceX, sin competencia, sin arquitectura abierta y sin aprovechar un ecosistema espacial dinámico”, y que podría hacer que el Pentágono “dependiera de su tecnología patentada”. Posteriormente, se adjudicaron contratos a York y a otras cuatro empresas para dar soporte a la red de comunicaciones espacial, pero por importes mucho menores: US$12 millones cada una, aunque existen posibilidades de que se adjudiquen contratos posteriores. Ver más: Musk insinúa una posible fusión entre SpaceX y Tesla al hablar de su estrecha colaboración En el informe de resultados del segundo trimestre de York, publicado en agosto, la empresa recortó en un 32% sus previsiones de ingresos para todo el año, alegando una ralentización en los contratos gubernamentales. Las acciones han caído más de un 70% desde su salida a bolsa en enero, y al menos nueve analistas han recortado sus objetivos de precio en una media del 54% desde el 14 de agosto, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg. Se ha presentado una demanda colectiva contra la empresa, en la que se alega que York indujo a error a los inversores en relación con sus operaciones comerciales, las perspectivas de contratación y la preparación de sus satélites. Mientras tanto, SpaceX se ha convertido en una de las empresas más involucradas, tanto pública como intensamente, en el proyecto ‘Golden Dome’. Además de la red de comunicaciones, la empresa se ha adjudicado un contrato para una red de seguimiento de misiles y el programa de interceptores espaciales, y forma parte de un consorcio industrial que desarrolla el software de ‘Golden Dome’. “El problema con el que se tropieza es que, en estos momentos, solo hay una empresa capaz de fabricar satélites como estos a la escala y con la rapidez necesarias”, afirmó Todd Harrison, investigador sénior en materia de defensa del American Enterprise Institute. “Esto va a prolongar la dependencia, al menos en un futuro previsible”. Ver más: SpaceX prevé lanzar su centro de datos orbital con chips de Nvidia a finales de 2027, según Musk SpaceX cuenta además con un aliado cercano en la persona del secretario de la Fuerza Aérea, Troy Meink, quien supervisa la Fuerza Espacial, según fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto. Meink había ocupado el cargo de director de la Oficina Nacional de Reconocimiento, que, bajo su liderazgo, creó una red de inteligencia utilizando los satélites de SpaceX. En febrero de 2025, las senadoras demócratas Elizabeth Warren y Tammy Duckworth enviaron una carta a Meink, cuando se estaba barajando su candidatura para el cargo que ocupa actualmente, en la que expresaban su preocupación por un posible trato de favor hacia SpaceX. La carta se produjo tras conocerse un informe según el cual el organismo de control interno del Pentágono estaba investigando si Meink había desviado indebidamente un contrato hacia SpaceX. Según las respuestas por escrito que Meink facilitó a los legisladores, Musk estuvo presente en la entrevista que Meink mantuvo con Trump para el cargo de secretario de la Fuerza Aérea. En mayo, la Fuerza Espacial adjudicó a SpaceX otro contrato ‘Golden Dome’ por valor de US$4.000 millones dpara construir satélites destinados a rastrear aeronaves y misiles extranjeros. Según personas familiarizadas con el asunto, la Fuerza Espacial había querido adjudicar el contrato en exclusiva a SpaceX, algo que el gobierno puede hacer si existe una necesidad operativa urgente o si solo hay un proveedor. Ver más: SpaceX lanza telescopio espacial de la NASA destinado a la búsqueda de energía oscura SpaceX tendría que desarrollar paneles de radar avanzados, algo que aún no fabricaba, pero que sí producían otros proveedores, según personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Sin embargo, incluso después de que el Congreso presionara a la Fuerza Espacial para que abriera la licitación a otras empresas, los requisitos relativos a la capacidad de lanzamiento y producción seguían siendo tan exigentes que solo SpaceX podía cumplirlos. La llegada de SpaceX como la niña bonita del Pentágono supone un giro irónico respecto a sus primeros años, cuando tuvo que abrirse paso entre el dominio de la empresa conjunta United Launch Alliance —formada por Boeing Co. ( BA ) y Lockheed Martin Corp. ( LMT )— para poder licitar en lanzamientos relacionados con la defensa. En la actualidad, SpaceX se hace cargo de la mayoría de los lanzamientos relacionados con la seguridad nacional de EE.UU. y cuenta con el mayor contrato —por un valor de hasta US$5.900 millones— para lanzar cargas útiles de seguridad nacional durante los próximos cinco años. Este año, la Fuerza Espacial adjudicó a SpaceX cinco lanzamientos de seguridad nacional y a United Launch Alliance solo dos. Ver más: SpaceX puso la mira en otra empresa de IA: intentó adquirir Cognition, valorada en US$26.000 millones La Fuerza Espacial ha intentado incorporar a otros competidores. Tras las presiones del Congreso y de la Oficina de Gestión y Presupuesto, creó un grupo de proveedores para la red de seguimiento de misiles aéreos con otras empresas, entre ellas Blue Origin LLC y Rocket Lab Corp., y posteriormente adjudicó tres contratos por un valor total de US$615 millones. Aun así, SpaceX sigue desempeñando un papel desmesurado a la hora de poner en órbita cargas útiles de seguridad nacional de EE.UU. Tal dominio expone a los programas de defensa a los caprichos de Musk, quien ha mantenido una relación tumultuosa con Trump. En junio de 2025, por ejemplo, tras un desentendido entre ambos por el paquete fiscal emblemático de Trump, Musk amenazó con retirar de servicio la cápsula Dragon de SpaceX, que transporta a los astronautas hacia y desde la Estación Espacial Internacional. York, por su parte, mantiene la esperanza de que los legisladores puedan presionar a la Fuerza Espacial para que permita una mayor competencia. “Necesitamos conseguir contratos”, declaró el CEO de York, Dirk Wallinger, en una conferencia celebrada en septiembre. “El gobierno reconoce —francamente, está recibiendo bastante presión por parte del Congreso— que es necesario que haya más competencia”. -Con la colaboración de Arvelisse Bonilla Ramos y Ted Mann. items.title: Prometidas eleições na Venezuela enfrentam longos atrasos, dizem fontes
items.author: Vivian Sequera, Mayela Armas, Anthony Esposito
items.creator: Vivian Sequera, Mayela Armas, Anthony Esposito
items.summary: A tão esperada votação na Venezuela pode não ocorrer por um ano ou mais devido às reformas previstas nos tribunais e nas autoridades eleitorais, disseram cinco fontes políticas e analistas, apesar da promessa da presidente interina Delcy Rodríguez de uma transição para a “democracia plena”.
items.body:
A tão esperada votação na Venezuela pode não ocorrer por um ano ou mais devido às reformas previstas nos tribunais e nas autoridades eleitorais, disseram cinco fontes políticas e analistas, apesar da promessa da presidente interina Delcy Rodríguez de uma transição para a “democracia plena”.
Rodríguez, que assumiu o poder após uma operação dos Estados Unidos capturar o então presidente Nicolás Maduro em janeiro, disse à Assembleia Geral da ONU na quarta-feira que as instituições do Estado estavam se preparando para as eleições. Segundo ela, o governo havia iniciado negociações com a oposição e garantiria a participação plena, mas não apresentou um cronograma.
Cinco fontes, incluindo representantes de partidos próximos ao governo e à oposição, assim como analistas, afirmaram que ainda existem grandes obstáculos, como reformas institucionais complexas e pouca urgência aparente por parte de Washington para a realização de uma votação imediata.
Duas das fontes disseram à Reuters que é improvável que haja eleições antes do final do próximo ano.
REFORMAS COMPLEXAS No centro do atraso está a previsão de substituição de todos os 32 juízes da Suprema Corte e dos cinco diretores do Conselho Nacional Eleitoral, órgão eleitoral máximo. Grupos da oposição e observadores internacionais de direitos humanos vêm afirmando que os dois órgãos carecem de independência e que as reeleições de Maduro em 2018 e 2024 foram fraudulentas.
A reforma institucional está sendo discutida em negociações apoiadas pelos EUA entre o governo interino de Rodríguez e uma facção da oposição.
Mas mesmo após a posse de um novo conselho eleitoral, as autoridades ainda precisariam atualizar os cadernos eleitorais, garantir que todos os partidos possam concorrer e resolver questões operacionais básicas, como se a votação seria manual ou eletrônica, disse Oswaldo Martínez, da consultoria ORC, com sede em Caracas.
Esse processo, por si só, poderia levar até um ano, segundo duas fontes próximas às negociações.
ESTABILIDADE Autoridades norte-americanas também afirmaram que qualquer transição política deve ser acompanhada de estabilidade econômica e social, o que levanta mais questões potenciais sobre o cronograma eleitoral.
“O que ameaçaria uma república duradoura na Venezuela seria alguém ser eleito e herdar uma catástrofe total, econômica e social, colocando assim todo o projeto em risco”, afirmou o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, nesta semana.
Alguns críticos dessa posição afirmam que Washington colocou de lado a oposição do país e reduziu a urgência por eleições livres em favor de acordos envolvendo petróleo e investimentos com o governo interino.
No mês passado, o presidente Donald Trump anunciou uma iniciativa sem precedentes dos EUA para assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela.
“O governo Trump está, atualmente, priorizando a estabilidade econômica e acordos relacionados ao petróleo sob o governo de Delcy, com pouca urgência aparente para avançar em direção a uma nova votação”, disse Risa Grais-Targow, diretora para a América Latina da consultoria de risco político Eurasia Group.
“Isso, somado a algumas das mudanças institucionais necessárias, sugere que novas eleições não serão realizadas antes do final de 2027, no mínimo, com a possibilidade de que demorem ainda mais.”
PRIORIDADES CONFLITANTES María Corina Machado, a líder da oposição mais conhecida da Venezuela e ganhadora do Prêmio Nobel da Paz que vive no exílio, tem estado notavelmente ausente das negociações com o governo interino, já que seus esforços para retornar ao país têm enfrentado obstáculos.
Alguns parlamentares dos EUA têm clamado por eleições e afirmam que Washington não obteve concessões democráticas significativas do governo de Rodríguez.
“A estabilidade e a normalização econômica, fortemente centradas na participação comercial dos EUA, continuam sendo as prioridades”, disse Nicholas Watson, da consultoria Teneo, acrescentando que Washington e Caracas estão tratando a necessidade de transição política como um processo de “longo prazo” e “sem prazo definido”.
“Nenhum dos dois está tomando medidas decisivas rumo a um processo eleitoral”, disse Watson.

items.title: Wall Street Week | China’s Trade Reckoning, Syracuse’s Second Chance, Humanoids in Healthcare
items.summary: This week, Council on Foreign Relations President Michael Froman breaks down China's export machine, why twenty years of US pressure hasn't worked, and what happens next. And, can a $100 billion Micron factory transform Syracuse from a Rust Belt cautionary tale into a potential model for American reindustrialization? Plus, a bridge named for a hockey legend was meant to strengthen the supply chain between the US and Canada, but the neighbors can’t agree on their trade relationship. Later, with 760,000 care aide openings expected every year in the US and a $400 billion long-term care bill, humanoid robots are an early bet on technology filling the care gap. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Hornets G Kon Knueppel (hamstring) could miss start of season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Charlotte Hornets sharpshooter Kon Knueppel sustained a left hamstring injury during an offseason on-court activity and could miss the start of the regular season.
items.body:
Charlotte Hornets sharpshooter Kon Knueppel sustained a left hamstring injury during an offseason on-court activity and could miss the start of the regular season.
The Hornets said Friday that Knueppel and forward Grant Williams (right hamstring) will miss the preseason before being re-evaluated during the first week of the regular season. The Hornets open the campaign on Oct. 21 against the host Brooklyn Nets.
Knueppel, who turned 21 last month, became the first rookie to lead the NBA in 3-pointers last season when he knocked down 273. He shot 42.5% from long range while averaging 18.5 points, 5.3 rebounds and 3.4 assists.
Knueppel finished second in NBA Rookie of the Year balloting behind former Duke teammate Cooper Flagg of the Dallas Mavericks.
The 6-foot-6 Knueppel was the fourth overall pick of the 2025 draft. The plan is to depend on him in the lead role more often after the offseason trade of LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves.
Williams, also hurt during an on-court activity, averaged 7.0 points and 3.9 rebounds in 36 games (three starts) for Charlotte last season. He is beginning his third full season with the Hornets after ACL and meniscus tears sustained in November 2024 led him to miss nearly 13 months.
Williams, 27, has averaged 7.2 points and 3.7 rebounds in 416 career games (111 starts) in seven seasons with the Boston Celtics (2019-23), Dallas Mavericks (2023-24) and Hornets.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Indian biscuit maker Anmol Industries files for $188 million IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indian biscuit maker Anmol Industries has filed for an initial public offering worth up to 18 billion rupees ($187.87 million), draft papers showed on Friday.
items.body:
Indian biscuit maker Anmol Industries (ANMO.NS) has filed for an initial public offering worth up to 18 billion rupees ($187.87 million), draft papers showed on Friday.
The Baijnath Choudhary & Family Trust, Anmol's top investor with a roughly 84% stake, is the sole selling shareholder in the IPO. Anmol is not selling any new shares and will not receive proceeds.
Founded in 1994, Kolkata-based Anmol has a portfolio of biscuits, cookies and cakes offered through 70 brands and also exports to 31 countries.
Anmol's net profit jumped five-fold to 1.91 billion rupees in the year ended March 31, while revenue rose 28% to about 21 billion rupees.
It competes with listed rivals such as Britannia (BRIT.NS) , ITC (ITC.NS) and Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities (MRSB.NS) in the world's most populous country.
The IPO filing comes as primary market activity in India picks up pace after a muted first half of the year.
Anmol had attempted to go public in 2018 through a 7.5 billion rupee IPO and had received market regulator approval, but did not go through with the plan.
Intensive Fiscal Services, ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital Services are managing the offering.
($1 = 95.8125 Indian rupees)

items.title: Peso mexicano se debilita esta semana hasta su peor nivel en cinco meses tras decisión de Banxico
items.author: Arturo Solís
items.summary: Ciudad de México — El peso mexicano se debilitó hasta su peor nivel frente al dólar estadounidense en cinco meses al cierre de esta semana, luego de la decisión del Banco de México (Banxico) de ...
items.body: Ciudad de México — El peso mexicano se debilitó hasta su peor nivel frente al dólar estadounidense en cinco meses al cierre de esta semana, luego de la decisión del Banco de México (Banxico) de mantener la tasa de interés interbancaria sin cambios, la cual decide el costo del dinero en el país. La moneda mexicana cerró la cotización del viernes 25 de septiembre en MXN$17,68 por cada dólar estadounidense en el mercado spot, un retroceso semanal de 2,6% o MXN$0,45, de acuerdo con datos de Bloomberg. Mientras tanto, el índice dólar, conocido como DXY, el cual mide el desempeño de la moneda estadounidense en comparación con las seis principales divisas del mundo, cerró una ligera caída diaria luego de cruzar la barrera de los 100 puntos, un nivel no visto desde julio, por el aumento de la tasa de interés del banco central estadunidense, conocido como Reserva Federal. La moneda de México sigue liderando las pérdidas en una canasta de las 16 mayores divisas monitoreadas por Bloomberg, seguida por el dólar australiano y la libra esterlina. El peso es atractivo para inversionistas que utilizan la estrategia de carry trade, la cual consiste en endeudarse en monedas con tasas de interés más bajas e invertir los recursos en divisas con mayores rendimientos. La moneda mexicana muestra presión después de la decisión de Banxico de mantener la tasa de interés en 6,50% donde persisten expectativas de una Fed, como se conoce a la Reserva Federal, más restrictiva y con un diferencial de tasas más reducida, señaló el grupo financiero Monex en un reporte. Ver más: Banxico mantiene la tasa de interés en 6,50% en medio del tono restrictivo de la Fed “Esperaríamos que el tipo de cambio oscile en un rango entre MXN$17,63 y MXN$17,75, ante la persistente fortaleza relativa del dólar y la cautela asociada al entorno de tasas, a la espera del reporte local de la balanza comercial al inicio de la siguiente semana”, añadió la firma.

items.title: Yankees earn split of doubleheader with Orioles
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Rookie Spencer Jones and Anthony Volpe keyed a three-run sixth inning for the New York Yankees, who earned a doubleheader split with a 6-3 victory over the visiting Baltimore Orioles on Friday night.
items.body:
Rookie Spencer Jones and Anthony Volpe keyed a three-run sixth inning for the New York Yankees, who earned a doubleheader split with a 6-3 victory over the visiting Baltimore Orioles on Friday night.
The Yankees (93-68) won for the 12th time in 18 games and improved to 9-3 against the Orioles this season. New York earned the win after learning it was locked into hosting the wild-card series against the rival Boston Red Sox for the second straight season.
The Orioles had their four-game winning streak stopped and lost for the fourth time in their past 11 games. Baltimore (79-82) also clinched its second straight losing season.
Following walks by Heliot Ramos and Luis Garcia Jr. against reliever Josh Walker, Jones hit a bloop single for a 2-0 lead and the runners advanced a base on a fielding error by right fielder Rece Hinds. Two batters later, Volpe struck a double down the right field line that carried over Hinds' head and bounced into the stands.
Ryan McMahon had a pair of hits, including an RBI double for New York's first run in the fifth. He also started the seventh with a single and scored on Ramos' bloop base hit off Anthony Nunez.
Garcia followed that with an RBI single of his own to give the Yankees a 6-1 lead. Garcia's hit was only his fourth in his past 38 at-bats.
After New York opener Ryan Yarbrough allowed four hits and struck out five in 2 1/3 scoreless innings, Will Warren (11-6) allowed three hits and notched seven strikeouts in 3 2/3 shutout innings during his third relief appearance this season. Warren is likely to be on New York's postseason roster as a reliever after making 29 starts during the regular season.
In the top of the seventh, left fielder Cody Bellinger made a leaping catch on a sacrifice fly by Leody Taveras after Brent Headrick loaded the bases. Headrick capped his 81st appearance by striking out Hinds with two on.
Baltimore's Dylan Beavers homered in the ninth after hitting a grand slam in the opener. Beavers homered off Alexander Cornielle, who was making his major league debut. Taveras had an RBI double before Cornielle finished things with a pair of strikeouts.
Baltimore starter Brandon Young (9-6) allowed one run on two hits in five innings. The right-hander struck out six and walked three in an 82-pitch outing.
--Field Level Media
